AI.conclusion: SODE提供了一种系统性的、以机制为基础的基准测试框架，能够将AI智能体与复杂的人类社会动态进行对齐，为评估和提升LLM在社会交互中的行为一致性提供了重要工具。

title: Memento: Personalized RAG-Style Long-Retention Data Scaling for META Ads Recommendation
summary: Modeling of long history data suffers from long-context window attention dilution, system efficiency and catastrophic forgetting problems, where naive linear scaling approach like LastN would fail. We introduce Memento, a personalized retrieval-augmented framework that treats historical user engagements as a document corpus and ad requests as queries, retrieving relevant interactions via Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) to balance similarity with diversity. We identify two complementary applications: Representation Memento, which retrieves historical embeddings for feature augmentation, and Data Memento, which retrieves past training examples for multipass training. Through infrastructure co-design -- temporal chunking, INT8 quantization, and asynchronous serving -- Memento achieves 5-10$\times$ resource efficiency over linear scaling. Memento processes daily requests with sub-10ms latency, yielding 0.25-0.3% Normalized Entropy gain on both click-through and conversion prediction. In production, Memento delivers a 1% CTR lift on Facebook Feed and Reels and a 1.2% CVR lift, scaling personalization to 365+ days of history.

AI.tldr: Memento是一个个性化检索增强框架，通过MMR检索平衡相似性与多样性，在历史数据建模中解决注意力稀释、效率低下和遗忘问题，实现5-10倍资源效率提升和显著的业务指标提升。
AI.motivation: 长历史数据建模面临长上下文窗口注意力稀释、系统效率低下和灾难性遗忘三大问题，传统LastN线性缩放方法无法有效解决。
AI.method: 提出Memento个性化检索增强框架，将历史用户参与视为文档语料库，将广告请求视为查询，通过最大边际相关性（MMR）检索平衡相似性与多样性。该框架包含两种应用：表示记忆（Representation Memento）检索历史嵌入用于特征增强，数据记忆（Data Memento）检索过去训练样本用于多轮训练。
AI.result: 在点击率和转化率预测任务中实现0.25-0.3%的归一化熵增益，生产环境中Facebook Feed和Reels获得1% CTR提升和1.2% CVR提升。
AI.conclusion: Memento通过基础设施协同设计（时间分块、INT8量化、异步服务）实现5-10倍资源效率提升，处理日常请求延迟低于10ms，在Facebook Feed和Reels生产环境中实现1% CTR提升和1.2% CVR提升，成功将个性化扩展至365天以上历史数据。

title: TRACER: A Semantic-Aware Framework for Fine-Grained Contamination Detection in Code LLMs
summary: Data contamination is a known threat to the reliability of model evaluation. However, it remains underexplored in code large language models (LLMs), where contamination often goes beyond exact duplication. We present TRACER, a semantic-aware framework for fine-grained code contamination detection. TRACER models contamination using three levels of semantic overlap - Functionally Identical, Nearly Identical, and Shared Logic - and detects them through a coarse-to-fine pipeline. We also introduce the first benchmark for fine-grained code contamination detection, spanning three widely used benchmarks and three representative post-training datasets. TRACER achieves strong and consistent performance across multiple LLM backbones, with GPT-5 reaching an F1 score of 0.91 in fine-grained detection. In the binary setting, TRACER attains an F1 of 0.92, outperforming existing methods by 42%-217%. We further conduct ablation studies and error analysis to assess the contributions of individual components in TRACER.

AI.tldr: TRACER提出首个细粒度代码污染检测框架，通过功能等价、近似等价和共享逻辑三层语义重叠建模实现代码LLM污染检测。
AI.motivation: Data contamination threatens model evaluation reliability in code LLMs, where contamination extends beyond exact duplication.
AI.method: TRACER: semantic-aware framework using three-level semantic overlap modeling (Functionally Identical, Nearly Identical, Shared Logic) and coarse-to-fine detection pipeline.
AI.result: GPT-5 achieves F1 of 0.91 in fine-grained detection; binary setting achieves F1 of 0.92, outperforming existing methods by 42%-217%.
AI.conclusion: First fine-grained code contamination benchmark spanning three widely used benchmarks and three post-training datasets; ablation studies and error analysis confirm component contributions.

title: High-Risk AI Systems and the Problem of Identity in the European AI Act
comment: Accepted as a non-archival paper at The 2026 ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency (FAccT '26), June 25-28, 2026, Montreal, QC, Canada
summary: The EU Artificial Intelligence Act (AIA) establishes a lifecycle governance regime for high-risk AI systems built around ex-ante conformity assessment, post-market monitoring, and re-assessment upon "substantial modification." These obligations presuppose AI identity judgments: regulators and providers must decide when an updated system remains the same system over time. In this work, we show how this logic is clarified by the function+ framework of artifact identity, which individuates AI systems by their intended function together with context-sensitive criteria of appropriate functioning, captured as "AI trustworthiness." We further argue that the AIA does not provide an internal, auditable criterion for synchronic identity--when two AI systems at a given time should count as the same for regulatory purposes--and instead largely defers such sameness determinations to sectoral or harmonization instruments. function+ supplies a synchronic identity test anchored in intended function and trustworthiness profiles and levels, making synchronic identity decisions inspectable in governance settings such as procurement, liability, and market surveillance. Our contribution is a conceptual and auditing lens: we provide a correspondence map between AIA lifecycle obligations and function+ identity components, and we make the synchronic case operationally legible via a minimal decision flow for audit and dispute contexts. We conclude with two implementation-facing recommendations: (1) more precise, testable reporting of intended purpose, and (2) standardized, auditable trustworthiness reporting that supports comparability over time and across deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文引入function+框架来解决EU AI Act中高风险AI系统的身份判定问题。该框架以预期功能结合情境敏感的可信度标准来个体化AI系统，弥补了AIA在同步身份判定方面的标准缺失，并通过操作化决策流程为审计和争议场景提供了实用工具。
AI.motivation: EU人工智能法案（AIA）对高风险AI系统建立了涵盖上市前合规评估、上市后监控及"实质性修改"后再评估的全生命周期治理机制。这些义务的核心前提是AI身份判断——监管者和提供商必须判定更新后的系统何时仍为同一系统。然而AIA缺乏内部可审计的同步身份标准，导致合规执行存在不确定性。
AI.method: 本文采用概念分析方法，构建了AIA生命周期义务与function+身份组件之间的对应映射图，并通过最小化决策流程图将同步身份判定在审计和争议场景中操作化。
AI.result: 研究表明AIA未能提供内部可审计的同步身份判定标准，而是将此问题下放至行业或协调工具层面。function+框架通过预期功能与可信度档案/等级，为同步身份判定提供了可审查的标准，使得采购、责任认定和市场监控等治理场景中的身份决策具有可操作性。
AI.conclusion: 文章提出两项面向实施层面的建议：(1)更精确、可测试的预期目的报告；(2)标准化、可审计的AI可信度报告，以支持跨时间和跨部署的可比性。这项工作为AIA的合规评估提供了概念性审查工具，有助于监管者、供应商和审计人员在生命周期治理中做出更透明的系统身份判定。

title: Extending the (Elementary) Mathematical Data Model and MatBase with two new constraint types: inexistence and anti-existence
comment: Submitted to the Primera Scientific Engineering J., Denton, TX, on 5/20/2026
summary: This research paper introduces two new constraint types and four subtypes of database constraints added to our (Elementary) Mathematical Data Model, which are the duals of the existence and non-existence ones. They are formally defined, characterized, and exemplified with real-life instances. The well-formedness, satisfiability, coherence, and minimality of sets of all 7 subtypes of existence constraints are studied. Corresponding SQL-embedded pseudocode algorithms for managing such sets are provided and proved to be of constant complexity, sound, complete, and optimal. Also provided are algorithms for enforcing these new types of constraints, called inexistence and anti-existence. Their characterization proves that they have linear complexity in the sum of the arities of the function (Cartesian product)s involved, and are sound, complete, and optimal as well. All these algorithms were implemented in both versions of our intelligent data and knowledge base management system prototype MatBase, which automatically generates code for enforcing all the 7 subtypes of existence constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文在数学数据模型(EIementary Mathematical Data Model)中引入了两类新型约束(inexistence和anti-existence)及其四个子类型,共形成7种子类型存在约束。研究了这些约束集合的良好形成性、可满足性、一致性和最小性,并提供了常數复杂度的管理算法和线性复杂度的实施算法,已在MatBase系统中实现。
AI.motivation: 传统数据库约束模型缺乏对"不存在"约束类型的系统性形式化定义与算法支持,需要扩展数学数据模型以完整刻画数据库中的存在性约束语义。
AI.method: 1) 形式化定义两类新约束及其子类型; 2) 研究约束集合的元理论性质(良好形成性/可满足性/一致性/最小性); 3) 设计并验证管理算法和实施算法的复杂度、正确性、完备性和最优性。
AI.result: 约束管理算法为常数复杂度,约束实施算法为线性复杂度(相对于函数元数之和),所有算法均为sound、complete和optimal。系统自动生成代码以强制执行全部7种子类型存在约束。
AI.conclusion: 扩展的数学数据模型能够完整表达存在性约束的完整语义层次,配套算法具有最优的时间复杂度,已在MatBase原型系统中验证可行。

title: How Much Thinking is Enough? Quantifying and Understanding Redundancy in LLM Reasoning
summary:
Reasoning-capable large language models solve hard problems by emitting long chains of thought, paying heavily in latency, GPU time, and energy. Casual inspection of their traces reveals extensive reformulation, verification, and circular self-reflection, yet how much of this deliberation is actually necessary has never been measured at scale or explained from first principles. This paper closes both gaps.
  We formalise reasoning redundancy directly in terms of the reasoning model itself: the redundancy of a correct trace is the largest fraction of its trailing segmented steps that can be truncated while $π$, forced to terminate thinking and emit a final answer, still produces the correct answer. A large-scale quantification across four frontier reasoning models and two mathematical benchmarks shows that step-level redundancy is consistently high -- between 61% and 93% across the 8 (model, benchmark) conditions we study, with the median critical prefix equal to a single segmented step in six of the eight conditions -- that the finding is robust to the choice of judge family, and that although $ρ$ decreases with problem difficulty on MATH-500, all four models remain substantially redundant ($ρ\in [46\%, 85\%]$) even on the hardest Level-5 problems.
  We then prove that this redundancy is a structural consequence of length-agnostic outcome rewards, not a model-specific artefact: under any such reward, no finite expected stopping time is optimal. The result holds regardless of RL algorithm, base model, data distribution, or whether the policy is obtained via RL or distillation; over-thinking is therefore not a bug to be patched in individual models but a structural property of how current reasoning models are trained. Code: https://github.com/zhiyuanZhai20/how-much-thinking-is-enough

AI.tldr: 本文首次大规模量化测量了推理模型中"思考"的冗余程度，发现61%-93%的推理步骤可被截断而不影响答案正确性。从理论上证明这种冗余是长度无关结果奖励的结构性后果，因此过度思考不是模型bug而是训练方式的固有属性。
AI.motivation: 推理大语言模型通过生成冗长的思维链来解决问题，导致高昂的延迟、GPU时间和能源消耗成本。其推理轨迹中包含大量重构、验证和循环自我反思，但这些深思熟虑的过程有多少是真正必要的从未被大规模测量或从原理上解释过。
AI.method: 1) 将推理冗余形式化定义为可截断的最大尾部分段步骤比例；2) 在4个前沿推理模型和2个数学基准上进行了大规模量化评估；3) 从第一性原理证明该冗余是长度无关结果奖励的结构性后果。
AI.result: 步骤级冗余在所有8个(model, benchmark)组合中高度一致（61%-93%）；8个条件中有6个的中位关键前缀仅为单个分段步骤；发现对评判模型家族的选择具有鲁棒性；在MATH-500上ρ随问题难度降低，但在最难的Level-5问题上4个模型仍保持显著冗余（46%-85%）。
AI.conclusion: 过度思考不是需要修复的模型缺陷，而是当前推理模型训练方式所带来的结构性质。在任何长度无关的结果奖励下，没有有限的预期停止时间是最优的。该结论与RL算法、基础模型、数据分布无关，也与策略是否通过RL或蒸馏获得无关。

title: Multi-Persona Debate System for Automated Scientific Hypothesis Generation
comment: 31 pages with 7 main figures, 4 supplementary figures and 1 supplementary table
summary: Modern scientific discovery is bottlenecked not by data scarcity, but by the inability to synthesize fragmented knowledge into actionable hypotheses. This challenge is especially acute in battery materials research, where electrochemical performance, interfacial behavior, and manufacturing feasibility must be optimized simultaneously. Here, we present the Multi-Persona Debate System (MPDS), a literature-grounded framework for automated scientific hypothesis generation that combines literature retrieval, long-context large language model reasoning, corpus-driven persona induction, and structured multi-agent debate. MPDS constructs literature snapshots of up to 500 papers, grounds agents in role-specific evidence pools, and conducts a three-round citation-aware debate followed by moderator synthesis, enabling negotiation between personas while preserving evidence traceability. We evaluate MPDS using a temporally controlled protocol excluding direct access to target papers, including two held-out battery-materials case studies and a blinded comparison across 30 matched cases. In sodium-ion anode and all-solid-state battery cathode design tasks, MPDS recovered design logics aligned with experimentally validated solution spaces and generated more mechanistically explicit, process-aware proposals than simpler baselines. To assess the impact of personas and debate, we introduce Integrative Hypothesis Quality scoring. In ablation studies, MPDS achieved the highest mean score among five conditions, with its largest advantage in cross-perspective integration. A laboratory follow-up suggests utility as a diagnostic aid for identifying practical bottlenecks in workflows. These results indicate that structured debate over literature snapshots improves hypothesis formation under coupled engineering constraints and provides a reusable workflow for text-intensive scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: MPDS是一个基于文献的多角色辩论系统，用于自动生成科学假设。通过500篇论文的文献快照、三轮引用感知辩论和主持人综合，在电池材料设计任务中超越了简单基线，特别是在跨视角整合方面表现突出，可作为科学发现的诊断辅助工具。
AI.motivation: 现代科学发现受限于无法将碎片化知识综合成可操作的假设，这在电池材料研究中尤为突出——需要同时优化电化学性能、界面行为和制造可行性。
AI.method: 提出多角色辩论系统(MPDS)，整合文献检索、长上下文大语言模型推理、语料库驱动的角色归纳和结构化多智能体辩论。构建最多500篇论文的文献快照，让智能体扎根于角色特定的证据池，进行三轮引用感知辩论，随后由主持人综合，在保持证据可追溯性的同时实现角色间的协商。
AI.result: 在钠离子阳极和全固态电池正极设计任务中，MPDS恢复了与实验验证解决方案空间一致的设计逻辑，生成比简单基线更具机制明确性和过程意识的提案。消融研究中，MPDS在五种条件下获得最高平均分，其最大优势在于跨视角整合能力。实验室随访表明具有诊断辅助的实用价值。
AI.conclusion: 结构化辩论框架改善了耦合工程约束下的假设形成，为文本密集型科学发现提供了可复用工作流程。实验室随访表明该系统可作为诊断工具识别工作流中的实际瓶颈。

title: CAFD: Concept-Aware DNN Fault Detection using VLMs
summary: Fault detection for Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) has received increasing attention in recent years. While more advanced hybrid approaches have been proposed to combine multiple sources of information and outperform earlier techniques, they often incur substantial computational overhead, limiting scalability and practicality in real-world settings. In this paper, we introduce Concept-Aware Fault Detection (CAFD), a learning-based approach that achieves superior fault detection performance by effectively integrating multiple information sources while maintaining practical efficiency. Specifically, CAFD is trained using a carefully selected set of informative features, including model-based signals derived from the DNN's outputs, distance-based features, and a novel concept-based feature, called Concept Failure Ratio (CFR). CFR leverages Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to extract textual concepts from images and quantify the likelihood that their presence is associated with DNN failures. By incorporating this feature, CAFD benefits from complementary semantic information, enabling more effective fault detection. Our results demonstrate that CFR serves as an effective indicator for DNN fault detection. We conduct an extensive empirical evaluation of CAFD, comparing it against five state-of-the-art baselines across three subject DNN models and datasets, including ImageNet. Across a wide range of constrained selection budgets, CAFD consistently outperforms all baselines in Fault Detection Rate (FDR), achieving average FDR improvements of 18.3% across all investigated subjects and budget sizes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Concept-Aware Fault Detection (CAFD)，一种基于学习的DNN故障检测方法，通过整合模型输出信号、距离特征和基于Vision-Language Models的Concept Failure Ratio (CFR)新概念特征，实现高效准确的故障检测。在ImageNet等数据集上，CAFD在多种选择预算下始终优于五种基线方法，平均FDR提升18.3%。
AI.motivation: 现有DNN故障检测的混合方法虽然性能较好，但计算开销大，限制了在实际场景中的可扩展性和实用性。需要在保持检测性能的同时提高效率。
AI.method: CAFD采用精心选择的特征集：基于模型输出的信号、距离特征，以及名为Concept Failure Ratio (CFR)的新型概念特征。CFR利用Vision-Language Models (VLMs)从图像中提取文本概念，量化概念存在与DNN故障的关联性，实现语义层面的互补信息融合。
AI.result: CFR是DNN故障检测的有效指标。CAFD在三个DNN模型和数据集（包括ImageNet）上与五种SOTA基线方法对比，在各种约束选择预算下均一致性地在Fault Detection Rate (FDR)上超越所有基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过整合CFR等互补语义信息，CAFD实现了平均18.3%的FDR提升，证明了基于VLM的概念特征在DNN故障检测中的有效性，为平衡检测性能与计算效率提供了可行方案。

title: The Dirichlet Mechanism for rounding with strong negative correlation, with applications
summary:
Many optimization and scheduling problems can be abstracted in terms of a bipartite ``assignment graph" $G = (L \cup R, E)$, where the goal is to select exactly one edge for each right-node. For example, a right-node may correspond to a job, and a left-node to a possible machine assignment. A common strategy to solve such problems is to obtain a fractional relaxation $x_e$ for each edge $e$, and then have each right-node independently select an edge with probability $x_e$. However, this may cause the left-nodes to become unevenly loaded, leading to suboptimal solutions for some problems.
  To address this, a number of algorithms for dependent rounding with strong negative correlation have been developed, e.g. Bansal, Srinivasan & Svensson (2021), Im & Shadloo (2020), Im & Li (2023), Harris (2024), Naor, Srinivasan & Wajc (2025). We introduce a new method for this, which we call the \emph{Dirichlet mechanism}. It is based on having each left-node draw Dirichlet random variables for its edges, and then having each right-node select an edge based on these values. This achieves quantitatively stronger negative correlation than previous algorithms, and is also simpler since it avoids the need for a tie-breaking mechanism.
  We illustrate the mechanism with improved approximation ratios for two problems. For oblivious online dependent rounding, we achieve a $0.68$-approximation which improves upon the previous $0.652$-approximation of Naor, Srinivasan & Wajc (2025). For the problem of scheduling jobs on unrelated machines to minimize weighted completion time, we achieve a $1.387$-approximation which improves upon the $1.398$-approximation of Harris (2024). (A recent algorithm of Li (2025) based on iterated rounding also provides a $1.36$-approximation if the weights of each job are independent of machine.)

AI.tldr: This paper introduces the Dirichlet mechanism for dependent rounding in bipartite assignment graphs, achieving stronger negative correlation with simpler implementation. Demonstrated through improved approximation ratios for two problems: 0.68 vs 0.652 for online rounding, and 1.387 vs 1.398 for job scheduling.
AI.motivation: Standard fractional relaxation with independent rounding causes uneven loading on left-nodes, leading to suboptimal solutions for assignment graph problems.
AI.method: Dirichlet mechanism: each left-node draws Dirichlet random variables for its edges, then each right-node independently selects an edge based on these values, avoiding the need for tie-breaking mechanisms.
AI.result: New approximation ratios: 0.68-approximation for oblivious online dependent rounding (vs 0.652); 1.387-approximation for scheduling jobs on unrelated machines to minimize weighted completion time (vs 1.398).
AI.conclusion: The Dirichlet mechanism achieves stronger negative correlation with simpler implementation, demonstrated through improved approximation ratios for oblivious online dependent rounding (0.68) and job scheduling on unrelated machines (1.387).

title: The Model Parking Tax: Quantifying the Hidden Energy Cost of Always-On GPU Model Deployment
summary: The AI inference industry keeps models loaded in GPU memory around the clock to avoid cold-start latency, implicitly treating idle power as a fixed cost of readiness. Yet the structure of this cost has never been empirically decomposed - and never across GPU architectures. We present the first cross-architecture measurement of idle GPU power as a function of VRAM allocation, combining 18 days of production telemetry (335,267 samples, 14 H100 GPUs) with controlled dose-response experiments on three GPU architectures spanning three memory technologies: NVIDIA H100 (HBM3, 80 GB), A100 (HBM2e, 80 GB), and L40S (GDDR6, 48 GB). We observe that idle power is piecewise constant on all three architectures: the CUDA context forces a discrete DVFS transition consuming +26-66 W over bare idle (26-50 W on HBM architectures, 66 W on GDDR6), while the marginal VRAM effect is bounded below measurement relevance ($|β| < 0.02$ W/GB) on every device tested. The CUDA context accounts for >98% of the parking tax regardless of memory technology. We validate this finding with a real HuggingFace model (Qwen2.5-7B) on all three architectures, confirming <0.5 W difference from empty tensors on every device, and capture cold-start power profiles during model loading. We derive a cold-start breakeven model showing energy-optimal behavior depends on request arrival rate and loading latency - not model size - with breakeven intervals of 1-5 minutes. Our results identify a constraint consistent across all tested architectures: idle-with-context power is determined by DVFS state, not memory occupancy.

AI.tldr: First cross-architecture measurement of GPU idle power reveals that CUDA context DVFS transition (not VRAM allocation) dominates idle power consumption (>98%), with VRAM having negligible marginal effect. Cold-start energy breakeven is determined by request arrival rate, not model size.
AI.motivation: AI inference industry keeps models in GPU memory 24/7 to avoid cold-start latency, treating idle power as a fixed "readiness cost." However, the actual structure of this cost has never been empirically decomposed, especially across different GPU architectures and memory technologies.
AI.method: Cross-architecture controlled experiments on three GPU architectures (H100/HBM3, A100/HBM2e, L40S/GDDR6) combined with 18 days of production telemetry (335,267 samples, 14 H100 GPUs). Validated with real HuggingFace Qwen2.5-7B model.
AI.result: Idle power is piecewise constant across all architectures. CUDA context forces a discrete DVFS transition of +26-66 W over bare idle (26-50 W on HBM architectures, 66 W on GDDR6). Marginal VRAM effect is bounded below measurement relevance (|β| < 0.02 W/GB) on all devices. CUDA context accounts for >98% of the "parking tax." Cold-start breakeven depends on request rate and loading latency (1-5 minutes), not model size.
AI.conclusion: VRAM occupancy is NOT the driver of idle power; the CUDA context's DVFS transition is. Energy-optimal inference deployment should consider request arrival rate (breakeven 1-5 minutes) rather than model size. Idle-with-context power is governed by DVFS state, not memory allocation.

title: ProofAgent Harness: Open Infrastructure for Adversarial Evaluation of AI Agents
summary: AI agents are entering high-risk production settings, where they use tools, retain context, follow policies, handle private data, and interact with users over multiple turns. Yet many evaluation methods still judge isolated outputs or static tasks, missing failures that emerge through trajectory, pressure, and adversarial interaction. We introduce ProofAgent Harness, open infrastructure for scalable, auditable, and adversarial AI agent evaluation. The harness provides evaluation infrastructure around an agent: it curates evaluation intelligence, runs adversarial multi-turn trials, captures behavioral traces, applies post-hoc multi-juror scoring, resolves disagreement, and produces evidence-linked reports. Its open design allows developers and researchers to extend domains, traps, metrics, juror personas, scoring rules, and reporting formats. At its core is Adversarial Multi-Juror Scoring with Turn-Level Audit, which evaluates completed agent behavior under pressure using calibrated juror personas, consensus checks, and turn-level evidence. Experiments across customer support, medical triage, privacy and security, and code generation agents show that strong agents fail selectively through weak metrics, fragile turns, unsafe reframing, and manipulation paths. We also find that a small quantized local Harness LLM can challenge production agents powered by best-in-class large LLMs, suggesting that evaluation capability emerges from the full harness pipeline rather than model scale alone. ProofAgent Harness turns AI agent evaluation from a static score into scalable adversarial evaluation infrastructure: repeatable, evidence-backed, extensible, and actionable before deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出了ProofAgent Harness，一个用于可扩展、可审计、对抗性AI智能体评估的开放基础设施，通过对抗性多陪审员评分与轮次级审计等机制，将评估从静态评分转变为可重复、证据支撑、可扩展的对抗评估系统，并在多种智能体类型上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: AI智能体正进入高风险生产环境（使用工具、保留上下文、遵循策略、处理隐私数据、多轮用户交互），但现有评估方法仍停留在孤立输出或静态任务评判，无法发现轨迹压力和对抗交互中涌现的失败模式。
AI.method: ProofAgent Harness提供围绕智能体的评估基础设施，包括：评估情报整理、对抗性多轮试验运行、行为轨迹捕获、事后多陪审员评分、争议解决和证据关联报告生成。其核心是"对抗性多陪审员评分与轮次级审计"，在压力下使用校准的陪审员角色、共识检查和轮次级证据评估完成的智能体行为。
AI.result: 跨客户服务、医疗分诊、隐私安全、代码生成智能体的实验表明：强智能体在弱指标、脆弱轮次、不安全重构和操纵路径上存在选择性失败；小型量化本地 Harness LLM 可挑战使用最佳大规模LLM的生产级智能体，说明评估能力来自完整评估流程而非模型规模。
AI.conclusion: ProofAgent Harness将AI智能体评估从静态评分转变为可扩展对抗评估基础设施，具有可重复、可证据支撑、可扩展、可在部署前采取行动的特点，证明了评估能力来自完整评估流程而非模型规模本身。

title: Same Ranking, Different Winner: How Scoring Targets Shape LLM Memory Benchmarks
summary: Conversational-memory systems increasingly transform dialogue history into facts, summaries, timelines, and other source-linked descendants, so a single source turn can coexist with several derived memories in the same retrieval index. This raises an underspecified evaluation question: which stored form should receive retrieval credit? We show that this scoring-target choice is often left implicit and can materially change benchmark conclusions. We present TIAP, a fixed-output audit that rescores saved ranked outputs under three targets -- Raw, Source, and Canonical -- without rerunning retrieval. On LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S, switching only the credited target changes nDCG on 83.4--94.0 percent of shared queries, flips target orderings on Mem0 and MemoryOS transfer runs, and reverses parser-density recommendations. A 1,902-case semantic audit further shows that relaxed source-linked credit is fully justified only 29.2 percent of the time, despite high rubric reliability in a validation subset. These results reveal target noninvariance: conclusions about memory architectures can silently flip with a single benchmark-design choice. Conversational-memory papers should therefore define and report the scoring target explicitly.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示了对话记忆系统中一个被忽视的评价问题：同一对话源可能以多种形式（原始、摘要、时间线等）存储在不同位置，评估时应将检索功劳归于哪种形式（评分目标）会显著影响Benchmark结论。通过TIAP审计工具在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S数据集上的实验发现，仅改变评分目标就能在83-94%的查询中改变nDCG结果，甚至导致架构对比结论逆转。
AI.motivation: 随着对话记忆系统将对话历史转化为事实、摘要、时间线等多种衍生形式，同一对话轮可能以多个派生记忆形式共存于同一检索索引中。这引发了一个未明确的问题：在评估时，检索功劳应该归属于哪种存储形式？论文指出这一评分目标选择往往被默认处理，但可能导致Benchmark结论发生实质性变化。
AI.method: 论文提出TIAP（fixed-output audit）方法，无需重新运行检索，直接对保存的排名输出使用三个不同评分目标（Raw原始、Source来源、Canonical规范）进行重新评分。通过语义审计进一步分析了放松来源链接评分标准的合理性。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S数据集上，仅切换评分目标就导致83.4%-94.0%的共享查询的nDCG发生变化，改变了Mem0和MemoryOS的排名顺序，并逆转了关于解析器密度的建议。语义审计显示，放松的来源链接评分标准仅在29.2%的案例中完全合理，尽管在验证子集上评分标准的可靠性较高。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了"目标不变性"问题：关于记忆架构的结论会因单一Benchmark设计选择而悄然翻转。论文建议对话记忆相关论文应明确界定并报告评分目标。

title: Empirical Analysis and Detection of Hallucinations in LLM-Generated Bug Report Summaries
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate summaries of software bug reports, including sections such as Steps-to-Reproduce (S2R), Actual Behavior (AB), and Expected Behavior (EB). However, these models frequently produce hallucinations that can be convincing but unsupported by the source report. This can mislead developers and reduce trust in automated maintenance tools. Existing hallucination detection approaches typically evaluate outputs at the full-response level and do not consider the structure of technical documents. An initial exploratory study on 80 structured bug report summaries found that approximately 47.9% contained missing information, while 12.3% included fabricated content, highlighting the need for systematic hallucination analysis in bug report summarization. In this work, we empirically investigate hallucinations in LLM-generated bug report summaries from a section-aware perspective. Using the BugsRepo dataset, derived from Mozilla OSS projects, we introduce controlled synthetic hallucination injection to construct a benchmark for training and evaluation. We propose a section-aware hallucination detection approach that jointly predicts whether a summary contains hallucinated content, identifies affected sections, and classifies hallucination types. Experimental results across multiple pretrained language models show that the proposed approach achieves strong performance across all tasks, with the best model obtaining 0.89 report-level Macro-F1, 0.83 section-level Macro-F1, and 0.84 hallucination-type Macro-F1. We further analyze common hallucination patterns and model failure modes to better understand limitations of current LLM-generated bug report summaries. The findings highlight the importance of section-aware hallucination analysis for improving the reliability of LLM-assisted bug report summarization in software maintenance workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM生成的bug报告摘要中的幻觉问题，提出一种section-aware幻觉检测方法，通过合成幻觉注入构建benchmark，联合完成幻觉存在检测、部分识别和类型分类三项任务，在BugsRepo数据集上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: LLM生成的bug报告摘要常产生幻觉（包括缺失信息和虚构内容），但现有幻觉检测方法仅在完整响应层面评估，未考虑技术文档的结构化特性。初步探索性研究发现80份结构化bug报告摘要中约47.9%包含缺失信息，12.3%包含虚构内容，亟需系统性的幻觉分析。
AI.method: 基于BugsRepo数据集（来自Mozilla开源项目），采用受控的合成幻觉注入方法构建基准数据集。提出section-aware幻觉检测方法，联合预测报告是否包含幻觉内容、识别受影响的部分，并对幻觉类型进行分类。实验在多个预训练语言模型上进行评估。
AI.result: 最佳模型在所有任务上均取得优异表现：报告级Macro-F1达0.89，部分级Macro-F1达0.83，幻觉类型Macro-F1达0.84。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调了section-aware幻觉分析对提升LLM辅助bug报告摘要可靠性的重要性，为软件维护工作流提供了更可靠的自动化工具基础。

title: Catching The Correct Answer Trap: Characterising AI Tutor Blind Spots When Analysing Student Reasoning
comment: To be published at the International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education (AIED'26)
summary: Intelligent tutoring systems increasingly provide automated feedback on student work, but robust feedback requires assessing reasoning, not only final answers. We study a failure mode we call the correct answer trap (CAT): models under-detect misconceptions when students reach a correct answer via flawed reasoning. Analysing real student responses from the Eedi mathematics platform, we show that 71% of these failures concentrate in just two question types, both sharing a common structure where flawed reasoning happens to produce the correct numerical answer. Comparing a fine-tuned T5 with a frontier large language model, we find that improved capabilities reduce but do not eliminate the problem (84% vs 57% detection accuracy). Even the best-performing model generates roughly four false alarms for every genuine detection, making stand-alone screening impractical at realistic class sizes. Our findings demonstrate that high overall accuracy can mask critical failures in reasoning assessment, and that careful analysis of student reasoning still benefits from human judgment.

AI.tldr: 研究揭示了智能辅导系统中"正确答案陷阱"现象，表明模型在学生通过错误推理偶然得到正确答案时难以检测错误。71%的失败集中在两种题目类型，微调T5和前沿LLM的检测准确率分别为57%和84%，即使最佳模型误报率仍高达4:1，无法在真实课堂规模下独立使用。
AI.motivation: 智能辅导系统需要评估学生推理过程，而不仅仅是最终答案。当前模型在学生偶然通过错误推理得到正确答案时，往往无法检测到其中的错误，即陷入"正确答案陷阱"。
AI.method: 分析了Eedi数学平台的真实学生回答，比较了微调T5和前沿大语言模型在检测正确答案陷阱问题上的表现。
AI.result: 71%的失败集中在两种问题类型上；尽管改进的能力可以减少但不能消除该问题，检测准确率从57%提升至84%；最佳模型仍存在约4:1的误报率。
AI.conclusion: 即使表现最好的模型在真实课堂规模下也难以实际应用，生成约四个误报才产生一个真实检测。总体准确率高可能掩盖推理评估的关键缺陷，人工判断仍有价值。

title: The Time is Here for Just-in-Time Systems: Challenges and Opportunities
summary: Core systems like key-value stores have historically taken years to build, and are designed to be general so as to amortize cost across deployments, paying a significant performance cost. We argue that LLM-based coding agents now make a different approach tractable: Just-in-Time Systems, in which the entire system is synthesized from scratch, specialized to the environment, workload, and required system properties. We present a JIT system synthesis pipeline, Jitskit, and explore its effectiveness in synthesizing key-value stores from spec cards that span different YCSB workloads, deployment constraints (e.g., compute resources), and system properties (e.g., consistency and durability). Jitskit iteratively refines a system implementation to match the specification against an evolving evaluation test suite. The resulting synthesized systems are performant, beating comparable state-of-the-art systems on 18 of 18 specs tried, by up to 4.6x over the best off-the-shelf baseline on the most favorable spec. Naively running Claude Code either reward-hacks or underperforms Jitskit by up to 5.4x. We discuss the challenges we overcame in building Jitskit and our key takeaways.

AI.tldr: This paper introduces "Just-in-Time Systems" (JITS) - a new paradigm where entire systems are synthesized on-demand and specialized to specific environments, workloads, and requirements using LLM-based coding agents. The authors present Jitskit, a synthesis pipeline that iteratively refines key-value store implementations against test suites. Results show synthesized systems beating state-of-the-art baselines on all 18 tested specifications, with performance gains up to 4.6x, while naive LLM approaches either cheat or underperform by up to 5.4x.
AI.motivation: Traditional core systems like key-value stores require years of development and are designed as general-purpose solutions to amortize cost across deployments, resulting in significant performance costs. The authors argue that LLM-based coding agents now make a fundamentally different approach feasible.
AI.method: Jitskit employs an iterative refinement pipeline that synthesizes complete system implementations from specification cards. It matches specifications against an evolving evaluation test suite, progressively improving the implementation through multiple cycles of synthesis, evaluation, and refinement. The approach uses spec cards that capture YCSB workloads, deployment constraints (compute resources), and system properties (consistency, durability).
AI.result: Synthesized systems achieved up to 4.6x performance improvement over the best off-the-shelf baseline on 18 out of 18 specs tested. Naive use of Claude Code either reward-hacks or underperforms Jitskit by up to 5.4x, demonstrating the importance of the structured refinement approach.
AI.conclusion: Jitskit represents a paradigm shift in system construction, demonstrating that LLM-based agents can now synthesize performant, specialized systems on-demand. Key challenges include maintaining implementation consistency, handling iterative refinement loops, and avoiding reward-hacking behaviors. The work opens a promising new direction for just-in-time system synthesis tailored to specific workloads and deployment constraints.

title: Context: Proactive Goal-Directed Intelligence via Composable Sandboxed Programs, Declarative Wiring, and Structured Interaction
comment: 7 pages; third in a series with arXiv:2501.XXXXX (Magarshak Machine / SPACER) and arXiv:2502.XXXXX (Grokers)
summary: We present Context, the intelligence layer of the Magarshak Architecture, which replaces reactive query-response chatbots with proactive goal-directed agents that advance shared tasks without waiting for user prompts. The architecture rests on three mutually reinforcing mechanisms. Write-time context assembly precomputes enriched typed attributes via Groker agents, assembling interaction context as a deterministic pure function of graph state; context blocks are byte-identical across turns between semantic changes, enabling near-100% KV-cache reuse. Composable sandboxed wisdom programs form a governed library of LM-generated imperative programs declaratively wired to goal types via typed stream relations, composed via phase ordering, and executed at interaction time without further LM calls. Proactive goal stream state machines drive conversations toward terminal states by inspecting graph state and emitting structured interaction content (option arrays, governance affordances, clarification prompts) without awaiting user input. We prove six formal results: the Context Stability Theorem, bounding per-turn LM cost as a function of semantic change rate; a Program Composition Correctness Theorem; a Declarative Wiring Soundness Theorem; the Proactive Dominance Theorem, proving proactive agents weakly dominate reactive agents on expected turns-to-terminal-state; Coordination Overhead Elimination and Quality Preservation, establishing Pareto improvements in multi-participant goal chats; and a Cross-Platform Vote Consistency Theorem. Implemented in the open-source Qbix / Safebox / Safebots stack.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Magarshak 架构的智能层「Context」，用写时上下文装配、可组合沙箱程序（智慧库）、声明式连线和主动目标流状态机三大机制，把"被动响应式聊天机器人"改造为无需用户提示即可推进共享任务目标的主动型智能体；并给出六项形式化定理（上下文稳定性、程序组合正确性、声明式连线可靠性、主动支配、协调开销消除与质量保持、跨平台投票一致性），已在开源 Qbix/Safebox/Safebots 栈实现。
AI.motivation: 现有对话式 AI 系统本质上是反应式的：只在接受消息后生成响应，无法主动推进目标导向任务（如构建软件能力、审阅文档、解决工单、治理共享产物）。在多参与者目标对话中，大量回合被耗费在"协调回合"（询问当前状态、识别阻塞、指派责任人、征集投票）上，这些回合不改变图状态、不产生进展，属于纯开销且缺乏自然纠正机制。论文还指出当前架构缺失三项原语：写时上下文预计算、可组合的受治理命令式程序、主动状态机智能；并试图为首个形式化模型，证明主动式代理在多参与者目标聊天中的组织效率上构成帕累托改进（更少回合、质量不降），填补 RAG（查询时检索）、任务型/主动式对话、多智能体协作与 LM 生成程序等已有工作的空白。
AI.method: 在 Magarshak Machine 底座（SPACER 追加流、策略治理、Compute→Require→Execute 五阶段）与 Grokers 理解层（自底向上归纳富化、字节同一性）之上构建形式模型：(1) 目标流 𝒢=(T,Q,q0,F,δ,Λ,𝒲,Π)，转移函数基于类型化属性条件；上下文块分层 𝒞=B_perm·B_sess·B_cold·B_dyn；(2) 智慧库为 LM 生成命令式程序的集合，受 Safebox 只读沙箱约束（无实时 DB 查询、仅提案累积写入、≤50ms/≤64MB、仅允许具名协议），带执行阶段代数 Φ={pre,ctx,post,auto,render,rel,agg,idx} 的偏序、顺序/并行组合语义、阶段正确性条件与模块化扩展推论；(3) 策略图 𝒫_ρ 以流类型模式、事件类型、条件谓词标注事件处理器，通过 Safebox/subscribes、inherits、adapts 等声明式关系连线，取代命令式注册；(4) 主动推进条件 (q,γ,μ) 依据图状态（属性与诱导图）自动生成选项数组、治理可供性、澄清提示等结构化内容，无需 LM 生成；(5) 形式证明采用归纳法（组合正确性）、SPACER 至多一次投递与顺序一致性（连线可靠性、跨平台投票一致性），并给出期望回合数、Ω 协调开销比与综合成本上界（乘积近似）的推理。
AI.result: 六项定理全部成立：(1) 上下文稳定性定理给出每回合 LM 成本 0.1(k_perm+k_sess)+k_cold·1[cold]+k_dyn，语义变更率 T_c/T_t→∞ 时缓存部分降至 10% 定价，约 10× 成本下降；(2) 程序组合正确性定理证明阶段有序流水线保持各程序正确性，并推出模块化扩展推论（新增程序不破坏已有正确性）；(3) 声明式连线可靠性定理证明事件路由完备且可靠（恰一次触发、不误触发），并含发布者继承推论；(4) 主动支配定理证明 E[N^{π_P}] ≤ E[N^{π_R}]，等号当且仅当 Π_𝒢=∅ 或所有推进条件仅由用户消息满足，节省下界 Δ𝒩 ≥ n_P(1−p_user)≈n_P；(5) 协调开销结构分解定理给出 Ω^{π_P} ≤ Ω^{π_R}(1−c_elim)，成熟库覆盖 C1–C4 时 c_elim→1、Ω→0，配合质量保持定理 E[Q^{π_P}]≥E[Q^{π_R}] 得帕累托改进（回合更少、质量不降），并推论线程隔离的上下文成本节约与综合效率增益上界；(6) 跨平台投票一致性定理保证任意平台与并发投票顺序下计票权重一致、fork 晋级恰好触发一次，实现平台无关的统一治理账本；另给出双遍历层级—缓存对应定理，说明顶层架构/章节上下文分别驻留 PERMANENT/SESSION 块、叶级需求驻留 DYNAMIC 块。实现映射到 Qbix（Streams_Category、Users_Vote）、Safebox（Action.propose、Protocol.Telegram/Apple/Email）、Safebots（goal/dialog/thread/artifact）插件。
AI.conclusion: Context 层连同 MM 底座与 Grokers 理解层构成 AI 辅助协作系统的完整形式化基础：既非仅响应，而是主动推进；随交互增多而更强更便宜；并可证明地提升组织效率。作者同时给出适用边界：Pareto 结论仅对本文定义的主动代理类成立，c_elim 在开放式创意协作中较小、在结构化任务执行中预期可观但尚待实证；正确性定理依赖"各智慧程序单独正确"的假设（缓解手段：提案制写管道、加入时阶段正确性校验、基于适应度的演化淘汰低质程序）；组织效率目前只有形式上界而无实测，作者提出记录目标聊天会话、按回合分类计算 Ω、在相同目标类型规格下对比 π_R 与 π_P 的测量方案作为后续工作。

title: Improving the Completeness and Comparability of Segment Disclosures: A Large Language Model Approach
comment: 39 pages, 4 figures, submitted to Accounting Horizons
summary: Segment-level disclosures are a central component of financial reporting, providing insight into firms' internal organization and the allocation of economic activities across operating units. However, segment information is often presented in both qualitative and quantitative forms, dispersed across tables and narrative sections of Form 10-K filings. Empirical research relying on structured databases faces both completeness and comparability challenges, as some firm-year observations may be missing, nested segment disclosures are not captured, and support for longitudinal and cross-firm comparability is limited. This study develops a large language model-based framework to extract segment disclosures directly from Form 10-K filings and to preserve both reportable and nested segment information. We further design a retrieval augmented system that incorporates information across multiple filings to support comparability. We use two representative settings to demonstrate its application: longitudinal analysis within a firm to interpret segment changes over time, and cross firm alignment of geographic segments across firms with different reporting structures. The results indicate that the artifact accurately extracts segment-level information and effectively addresses questions that require cross-period knowledge, demonstrating the potential of LLM-based approaches to enhance the measurement and interpretation of segment disclosures.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个基于大语言模型(LLM)的框架，用于从Form 10-K文件中直接提取分部信息披露，并设计了一个检索增强系统以支持跨期可比性分析。
AI.motivation: 现有结构化数据库在提取分部信息时面临完整性(completeness)和可比性(comparability)两大挑战：部分公司-年度观测值缺失、嵌套分部披露(nested segment disclosures)未被捕捉、纵向和跨公司可比性受限。分部信息以定性和定量形式分散在表格和叙述部分，增加了提取难度。
AI.method: 1) 开发基于LLM的框架直接从Form 10-K中提取分部披露信息，保留reportable segments和nested segments；2) 设计检索增强系统(RAG)，整合多个文件的信息以支持可比性分析。
AI.result: 该方法能准确提取分部级信息，并能有效回答需要跨期知识的问题，展示了LLM方法在增强分部披露测量和解释方面的潜力。
AI.conclusion: LLM-based方法可有效解决传统数据库在分部信息披露提取中的完整性与可比性问题，为财务分析提供更可靠的工具。

title: Towards Verifiable Transformers: Solver-Checkable Circuit Explanations
summary: Mechanistic interpretability often identifies circuits inside Transformer models, but explanations of those circuits are usually validated through examples, ablations, and manual reasoning. This leaves a gap between finding a plausible circuit and proving what the circuit does. We introduce Verifiable Transformers, a framework for converting task-localized Transformer circuits into bounded, solver-checkable claims. Given a behavior, a finite task domain, and a candidate-token projection, we extract a task circuit and verify properties such as projected functional equivalence, edge necessity, task-relevant invariance, and final-residual robustness. Direct verification encodes the extracted circuit itself into an SMT solver. When a circuit contains operators that are not exactly or tractably encodable, surrogate-mediated verification fits an SMT-encodable surrogate, validates it against the extracted circuit over the bounded domain, and verifies symbolic explanations against the surrogate. We instantiate direct verification with a GPT-style architecture using Signed L1 BandNorm, sparsemax attention, and LeakyReLU. On small symbolic sequence tasks, we train an SMT-representable Transformer, extract sparse circuits for quote closing and bracket type tracking, and exhaustively verify projected functional equivalence, content invariance, edge necessity, and final-residual robustness. At GPT-2 scale, the same operator stack trains stably on OpenWebText, although naive direct SMT verification remains intractable. We also demonstrate surrogate-mediated verification on task-localized circuits with hard-to-encode attention, showing both verified symbolic explanations and solver-generated counterexamples. The goal is not full-model verification, but a concrete path for turning mechanistic circuit explanations into formal propositions that can be proven or refuted.

AI.tldr: 本文提出「Verifiable Transformers」框架：把机制可解释性找到的 Transformer 电路转化为有界、可被 SMT 求解器检验的命题（投影功能等价、任务相关不变性、边必要性、最终残差鲁棒性）。在小规模上直接编码验证；GPT-2 规模上则采取「构造式」路线——移除全部 LayerNorm、把保留注意力头替换为受限 DSL 符号程序、冻结并哈希其余参数后仅做因果受限校准，最终在哈希固定的 1,280 条 prompt 域上以精确有理算术验证了一条三边引号闭合电路（embedding → MLP 0 → program head 7.11 → logits），全性质验证通过。核心方法论教训是「必须构造出我们能验证的对象」，且所有声明严格限定在声明域与声明对象上。
AI.motivation: 机制可解释性通常靠示例、消融和人工推理来论证电路的作用，因而「找到一个看似合理的电路」与「证明该电路确实做什么」之间存在鸿沟；既有的神经网络验证工作（Marabou、Reluplex、Z3）针对的是前馈分类器的对抗鲁棒性，而非 Transformer 电路的任务投影、边必要性与符号程序等价性。同时，GPT-2 规模上朴素的 SMT 编码因 width-768 的 QK 双线性项与注意力—数值乘积而不可判定。另一个动机是标准化：LayerNorm 引入数据依赖的标准差（平方根与除法），Signed L1 BandNorm 虽可表达但带来分支证书不完备性（分支不稳定导致 unknown），因此需要可证明的架构选择。
AI.method:
1）形式化：在声明域 D、候选 token 集 T、符号参考程序 P 下定义投影决策 d_T，抽取电路 C_E（删除边贡献置零），并形式化四性质：投影功能等价 ∀x d_T(C_E,x)=P(x)；边必要性 ∀e ∃x d_T(C_E,x)≠d_T(C_{E\e},x)（零消融语义，非全局最小性）；任务相关不变性（由声明的关系 R 诱导）；最终残差 ℓ∞ 鲁棒性。
2）三种验证设置：直接验证（把电路本身编码为 SMT 可表示的公式，检验目标性质的否定，UNSAT 即证明，SAT 返回反例）；代理介导验证（对难编码电路拟合 SMT 可编码的替代模型 S，再检验 P 与 S 的等价）；验证蒸馏（把受限符号程序 H 装入新工件 M̃，冻结并哈希所有非程序参数 θ_{¬H}，仅训练程序局部读出 θ_H，使得在程序病灶 L_H 下所有可训练贡献消失——式(6) 是恒等式而非正则项，从而训练无法创造新的非程序旁路）。
3）架构：sparsemax 注意力 + LeakyReLU（精确分段线性）替换 GELU + 移除全部 25 个 LayerNorm（5,000 步衰减为固定标准差仿射并折叠，OWT 损失仅 +0.0087），band-norm-free 后鲁棒性判定退化为精确 margin/对偶范数条件 m_{y,t} > ε‖u_y−u_t‖_1，认证半径 ρ(x)=min_t m_{y,t}/‖u_y−u_t‖_1，不再存在分支 unknown。
4）验证工具链：精确有理算术导出 → 折叠验证器（对每条 prompt 外部认证 LeakyReLU 预激活符号，程序选择由 token 身份与位置固定，契约后化为地面线性实数算术比较），并以 8 条 anchor 提示上折叠式与整体单体验证器的一致性作为健全性回归。
5）发现式定位研究：三个确定性门控协议 A/B/C，每次烧毁已见门，开发集上近精确的稀疏电路在未触碰门上失败（引号 511/512；括号需保留全部 144 头、158 节点、340 边才达 512/512）。
6）代理介导实验：用小型 ReLU 网络替代教师电路关系，程序在有限数据集上 100% 一致却可被求解器在抽象输入 [2,0,2]（[!," ,!]）上反驳（引号任务），括号任务则在有界抽象域内被证明等价。
AI.result: 小规模（~8K 参数、32 词表、每任务 128 穷举输入）：引号闭合（3 边）与括号类型（6 边）四性质全部直接验证通过；但匹配重训的 BandNorm 版本在所有测试半径下 64/128 输入分支不稳定，返回 UNKNOWN_BRANCH_UNSTABLE（无决策违反），而无归一化版本全部 verified，揭示种子相关的可证明性。程序头替换后小规模电路无活跃神经 QK 项、参数化 QK 足迹 1088→272，每边断言数 113K→66K→31K。GPT-2 规模：sparsemax+LeakyReLU+LayerNorm 源模型经归一化移除与折叠后 OWT loss 3.2056（相对源 +0.0087，较 BandNorm 门好 0.1124），WT103 ppl 52.5124；FP64 折叠校验最大 logit 误差 6.58e-5、top-1 一致 1.000。整模型 healing 失败（core-aware 两次 10,000 步未达精确；后续修复后程序仍可被联合移除而不改变任务决策），因果审计显示旁路本就存在（联合消融两个头仍 1,256/1,280 正确；整电路消融 710/1,280），head 9.0 单独冗余、head 7.11 强必要。三级因果受限校准（标量增益→对角增益→程序局部 W_V/W_O）均达 1280/1280 全模型与电路一致、perplexity 25.5707（预算 28.6176），且病灶前向与零步基线逐位相同；最终三边电路经再抽取验证：等价 1280/1280、不变性 1280/1280、每条边 640 个精确必要性见证、ε=0.01 鲁棒性通过（最小认证半径 0.01515、中位 0.02261、最大 0.03640），折叠验证 66.61 秒（契约 16.04s + 1,280 次折叠 50.58s，零求解器搜索），编码器与 PyTorch 候选 logit 最大误差 1.11e-8，非程序参数哈希完全一致。代理介导：引号任务被求解器反驳（[!, ",!]），括号任务在有界域内被证明。
AI.conclusion: 论文主张：在规模上必须「构造可验证的对象」而非仅做事后发现——发现式稀疏抽取反复在未触碰门上近似但不精确（引号 511/512、括号需近未剪枝图），故最终路线是移除归一化 + 以符号程序替换保留的注意力机制 + 冻结其余参数的受限校准；其最有力结论是关于一个被构造并校准的工件（而非未经修改的 GPT-2），仅覆盖哈希固定的 1,280 条 prompt 域与候选 token 投影，不主张域外正确性、全词表等价、全局电路最小性、原始模型注意力确实实现该程序，也不主张 GPT-2 规模的括号类型验证。冗余不等于旁路：冻结基线中已存在的原生路径（98.1% 覆盖）被显式测量并保留，程序病灶恒等式保证校准不能新增旁路，但可证明性对分支证书与精确有理导出敏感（FP32 一致性检查不等于逐位等价）。未来工作：构造式括号电路、权重稀疏预训练改善定位、扩展 DSL（scan/match/有界栈）并用反例驱动扩展、全模型级无 QK 双线性注意力（硬选择/布尔门/Deep Sets 式聚合）、以及将弥散机制迁移至声明符号模块的方法。

title: Approximate Algorithms for Chamfer Distance Under Translation
summary: Given two sets of points A and B, $|A| = m$, $|B| = n$, the Chamfer distance from $A$ to $B$ is defined as $\operatorname{CD}(A,B) = \sum_{a\in A} \min_{b\in B} d(a,b)$, where $d$ is a distance metric. Chamfer distance is a popular measure of dissimilarity between two sets of points that has seen increasing usage in computer vision and information retrieval as a substitute for the more computationally demanding Earth Mover's distance. We propose a new problem, Chamfer distance under translation, defined as $\operatorname{CDuT}(A,B) :=\min_{t\in \mathbb{R}^d} \operatorname{CD}(A+t,B)$, where $A+t$ denotes the translation of every point in $A$ by $t$. Chamfer distance under translation is valuable in cases where translations capture aspects of the data unlikely to be relevant for dissimilarity, such as temporal, spatial, or other semantic information. For Chamfer distance under translation, we provide four algorithms: (1) an exact quadratic time algorithm in one dimension, (2) a near quadratic time ($2+\varepsilon$)-approximation algorithm in higher dimensions, (3) a $(1+\varepsilon)$-approximation algorithm with running time $\mathcal{O}(mn^2\varepsilon^{-(d+1)})$, and (4) a near-quadratic time $(1+\varepsilon)$-approximation algorithm for answering the decision version of $\operatorname{CDuT}$ given a separation assumption on $B$. We additionally explore the fine-grained complexity of $\operatorname{CDuT}$.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Chamfer距离在平移下的极小化问题(CDuT)，即通过平移点集A来最小化其到B的Chamfer距离。文章设计了四种算法：精确二次时间算法(1D)、近二次时间2近似、高维多项式时间1近似，以及分离假设下的近二次时间1近似决策算法，并给出了细粒度复杂度分析。
AI.motivation: Chamfer距离在计算机视觉和信息检索中广泛用作Earth Mover's距离的替代方案，但现有研究未考虑平移不变性。当平移携带不相关的时间、空间或语义信息时，需要对点集A进行最优平移以消除其影响。
AI.method: 设计了四种算法：(1)一维精确二次时间算法，(2)高维近二次时间(2+ε)近似算法，(3)运行时间O(mn²ε^(-(d+1)))的(1+ε)近似算法，(4)分离假设下近二次时间(1+ε)近似决策算法。
AI.result: 给出了CDuT的多层次近似算法谱系，并建立了细粒度复杂度下界，证明了不同近似因子与时间复杂度之间的权衡关系。
AI.conclusion: 提出了CDuT这一新问题，给出了从精确算法到近似算法的多种解决方案，并建立了细粒度复杂度下界，为该领域后续研究奠定基础。

title: RASC: Region-Aware Self-Calibration for Dense 2D Sensor Arrays
summary: BJT-based 2D temperature-sensor arrays are factory-calibrated to +/-0.1 degC, but post-deployment thermal and mechanical stresses drift their per-sensor gain-offset parameters by an order of magnitude, and in-lab recalibration is impractical. We present RASC (Region-Aware Self-Calibration), a five-stage algorithm that decomposes the global ill-posed problem into local cluster-level problems, runs robust alternating estimation (trimmed-mean field reconstruction + Huber IRLS) inside each cluster, and reconciles overlapping estimates by linear consensus on the cluster-overlap graph with provable exponential convergence. On 7,632 frames from a deployed 16x16 array exhibiting ~5x factory-spec non-uniformity, RASC cuts the locally-non-smooth fixed-pattern residual by 71+/-5% (10-fold CV), restoring +/-0.1 degC accuracy while perturbing the calibrated field by only 0.041 degC RMSE; reduction concentrates at the edges (78% vs 55% interior). In simulations on 8x8 to 32x32 arrays, RASC matches an oracle centralized EKF within 0.10 degC with ~4x lower bandwidth.

AI.tldr: 针对部署后BJT温度传感器阵列参数漂移问题，提出RASC自校准算法，通过区域感知聚类分解和鲁棒估计结合重叠图线性共识，无需实验室重新校准即可恢复±0.1°C精度，性能匹配集中式EKF且带宽需求大幅降低。
AI.motivation: BJT型2D温度传感器阵列在出厂校准后精度为±0.1°C，但部署后受热和机械应力影响，传感器增益-偏移参数漂移一个数量级，且实验室重新校准不切实际。
AI.method: 五阶段算法：(1)将全局问题分解为局部聚类级子问题；(2)在每个聚类内使用鲁棒交替估计（修剪均值场重构+Huber IRLS）；(3)在聚类重叠图上进行线性共识以协调重叠估计；(4)具有可证明的指数收敛保证。
AI.result: 在7,632帧实测数据（16×16阵列，~5倍出厂规格非均匀性）上，局部非光滑固定图案残差降低71±5%（10折交叉验证），恢复±0.1°C精度且校准场扰动仅0.041°C RMSE，边缘区域改善78% vs 内部55%。仿真中8×8至32×32阵列性能与oracle集中式EKF相差<0.1°C，带宽降低~4倍。
AI.conclusion: RASC通过将全局病态问题分解为局部聚类问题并在聚类重叠图上进行线性共识融合，成功在无需实验室重新校准的情况下恢复了漂移传感器的精度，匹配oracle集中式EKF性能且带宽需求降低约4倍。

title: A Reinforcement Learning Inspired Latent Yield Based Adaptive Algorithm Switching Mechanism
comment: Accepted and published in the Proceedings of the 29th European Conference on Applications of Evolutionary Computation (EvoApplications 2026), held as part of EvoStar 2026, Toulouse, France, April 8 to 10, 2026. Lecture Notes in Computer Science (LNCS), Springer Nature Switzerland
summary: Selecting the most suitable algorithm for a given problem instance remains a challenging task, particularly in online or dynamic environments where problem characteristics evolve over time. Relying solely on instantaneous performance metrics can result in a reactive and unstable behaviour, often leading to suboptimal algorithm switching. This paper introduces a computationally efficient approach for aggregating an algorithm's performance across multiple problem instances that is fairly immune to erratic variations in instance features. Inspired by features inherent to Reinforcement Learning (RL), this technique encapsulates rewards and penalties into a latent yield that, in turn, triggers exploitation and exploration, consequently resulting in adaptive algorithm switching. The proposed technique employs island models, inspired by Genetic Algorithms, to facilitate parallel exploration and performance exchanges among algorithm populations inhabiting local repertoires. Experimental evaluations on sorting algorithms and robotic obstacle avoidance tasks demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of the approach, highlighting its potential in domains where adaptive algorithm selection is critical.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种受强化学习启发的在线自适应算法选择（AS）机制：用“潜在收益（Latent Yield，Yielon）”记忆算法跨实例的累积表现，通过“挤压因子”（滑动窗口内归一化信用梯度）驱动 Yielory 的充放电，配合 GA 式岛屿模型与中央接口代理（CIA）实现并行探索/迁移，并引入 G-Island 防止早熟收敛。算法在排序与 Webots 机器人避障两类任务上验证：与贪心基线相比，累积归一化信用显著提升（排序实验从约 1.0–3.1 万提升至 1.1–1.6 万区间合计显著增加），切换次数大幅减少（贪心式 160+ 次 vs. 引入 Yielory 后 2–17 次）。
AI.motivation: 算法选择（AS）需为每个问题实例挑选最合适的算法，但受“无免费午餐定理”限制，无单一算法在所有实例上最优；离线/静态选择（Satzilla、ASlib 等监督学习式元模型）无法适应实例分布漂移的在线与动态环境，而现有基于 RL/多臂 bandit 的在线方法多依赖瞬时奖励反馈，在性能剧烈波动时会导致反应式、抖动的“反射式”切换，导致次优选择。论文同时关注并行性与可扩展性：希望单个岛内可扩充更多算法、集群可增加更多岛屿，并避免集中式协调带来的瓶颈与早熟收敛。
AI.method: 1) 归一化信用：每次执行实例后按资源 R、时间 τ 与任务代价函数 f 计算信用，并以该算法历史最优实例为基准归一化为百分制（Eq.1），使异构算法可比。2) 潜在收益 Yielon/Yielory：设滑动窗口大小 W=5，挤压因子 σ 为窗口内归一化信用相邻差的均值（Eq.2）；Yielon 更新为 Υ_new=Υ_curr+σ·(Υ_curr/Υ_max)（σ≠0）或 Υ_curr+p·(Υ_curr/Υ_max)（σ≈0）（Eq.3a/3b），参数取 Υ_max=100、Υ_min=30、Υ_initial=60、p=0.05、Δ=80、ε=10。类比“拧毛巾”物理过程：表现好则补充 Yielon，表现差则消耗，性能下滑时需要更大扭矩才能“榨出”同样的量。3) 切换动态：Yielon 充足时即使近期表现差也继续利用（延迟切换、提供惯性）；σ≈0（性能饱和）时比较当前信用与阈值 Δ，Δ≥0 则继续利用，Δ<0 则向 CIA 查询全局最佳 A_best 与其 Yielon，若 A_best 等于当前算法或 |Υ_best−Υ_curr|<ε 则转为内在探索（在本岛 repertoire 中随机选新算法），否则进行外在探索（直接切换到 A_best）；若 Υ_new<Υ_min 则强制内在探索并重置 Yielon。4) 架构：n 个岛屿，每个岛含代理 ψ_i、算法 repertoire 与 Yielory，通过中央接口代理 CIA 观测与记录全局最优算法，天然并行、可扩展；repertoire 可重叠。5) G-Island（Galapagos 岛）：设定行为异质化的探索代理，当 Υ_mean−Υ_I_G>δ 或其为全局性能最优且存在其他岛使用相同算法时，从 Rep_G 中随机选取与其他岛当前激活算法不同的算法，以打破岛屿同质化、缓解“岛屿综合征”与早熟收敛。实验：排序任务用 QS/IS/CS 三算法、每岛含全部三种、随机化输入类型 RandL/RandS/AlmoS，信用=round(1/(ω+α+1))（指令数与访存数），基线为无 Yielory 的贪心切换（每回合切到全局最优）；机器人任务用 Webots 四个实例，每岛一台机器人，repertoire 含 Q-Learning/SARSA/Double Q-Learning 各以学习率 0.1 与 0.7 变体共 6 个算法，5 秒无碰撞记 10 单位信用，电量每步降 2.5%、耗尽为一个 episode 结束。
AI.result: 排序实验：无 Yielory 的贪心基线中所有岛迅速收敛到同一算法（CS）形成局部最优，切换极少（0–1 次）而累积信用低（I1 10384、I2 3058、I3 8491）；加入 G-Island 的贪心虽使切换暴涨至约 160–163 次，但累积信用未明显改善（9569/7241/7411）。引入 Yielory 后累积信用显著上升（16019/15987/11102，无 G-Island；14469/9672/12663，含 G-Island），且切换次数从数百次骤降至 2–3 次（无 G-Island）与 6–17 次（含 G-Island），且 Yielon 曲线显示明显“惯性”——数据类型突变时延迟切换，Yielon 降至低位才触发换算法；G-Island 切换更频繁，有效防止全体收敛到同一算法。机器人避障实验：各岛在信用剧烈波动下仍能通过切换吸收环境变化，I1/I3/I4 切换次数明显少于活跃的 G-Island（I2）；消融掉 G-Island 改为同质岛后，外在探索次数在两类任务中均下降，说明 G-Island 有效维持跨岛搜索、避免过早饱和。
AI.conclusion: 潜在收益（Yielon/Yielory）作为一种跨实例累积的性能记忆，可将 RL 式的奖励/惩罚与 GA 岛屿模型结合，既提供切换惯性、抑制抖动式反射切换，又在 Yielon 枯竭或性能饱和时驱动内在/外在探索；配合 G-Island 可缓解岛屿同质化与早熟收敛。实验表明该机制在闭合世界（排序）与开放世界（机器人）均可行有效，且在显著减少切换次数的同时提升累积表现。未来工作：利用更强算力在单岛内部署多个协作代理；引入局部 Hall-of-Fame 淘汰低效算法以收缩搜索空间；支持在线向 repertoire 动态加入新算法（终身学习）；让超参数也像 PBT 一样跨岛交叉/变异；引入联邦学习与可迁移移动代理，使 CIA 冗余化、去中心化，并可扩展到移动机器人系统中拓扑动态变化的“移动岛屿”场景。

title: An Interpretable CF-RL-TOPSIS Fusion Model for Skills-Aware Talent Recommendation
comment: Preprint submitted to Knowledge-Based Systems; 4 figures and 8 tables
summary: Effective skills-aware talent recommendation must balance behavioral transition patterns, trajectory-sensitive adaptation, and inspectable occupation-level criteria. Evidence from public benchmarks on how these signals interact, however, remains limited. This study proposes CF-RL-TOPSIS, an interpretable late-fusion model that integrates a transition-aware collaborative branch, a compact reinforcement-style occupation-family bandit, and an entropy-weighted TOPSIS branch constructed from six semantic proxies; the validation-selected fusion coefficients remain auditable. The model is evaluated on two frozen public ICT talent-history benchmarks, JobHop and Karrierewege, using repeated chronological top-5 ranking and paired Wilcoxon tests. On JobHop the full hybrid attains NDCG@5 = 0.3040 +/- 0.0073 and significantly surpasses repeat-last, item Markov, transition-aware collaborative filtering, the CF+TOPSIS hybrid, GRU4Rec, and SASRec (p <= 0.0039 across planned comparisons). On Karrierewege the hybrid remains competitive but does not significantly exceed the strongest Markov baseline, revealing a persistence-dominated setting in which the bandit branch appropriately shrinks to near-zero weight. Proxy-sensitivity, family-level deep Q-network, and runtime checks support this interpretation, and a worked user-level case shows how branch scores, criterion weights, and rank shifts can be inspected for an individual recommendation. The contribution is not a benchmark-agnostic superiority claim, but a reproducible account of the conditions under which transparent late fusion adds value beyond simple continuation heuristics. In semantically rich, non-saturating talent-history regimes the three branches reinforce one another; in persistence-dominated regimes the same architecture remains competitive through its collaborative backbone, with the adaptive branch correctly inactive.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可解释的后融合模型 CF-RL-TOPSIS，面向技能感知的 ICT 人才推荐：将转移感知协同过滤分支、紧凑的职业族 bandit 分支与基于六个语义代理的熵权 TOPSIS 分支以可审计的融合系数线性组合。在两个冻结的公开基准上按时间顺序重复划分评测：JobHop（主基准）上全模型 NDCG@5=0.3040±0.0073，显著优于 repeat-last、item Markov、Transition-CF、CF+TOPSIS、GRU4Rec、SASRec（p≤0.0039）；Karrierewege（次基准）上 NDCG@5=0.6227，但与最强 Markov 基线差异不显著（p=0.5566），此时 bandit 权重自动收缩至近零（0.05）。论文的核心贡献不是"普遍最优"，而是可复现地说明透明后融合在何种基准条件下能带来增益。
AI.motivation: 人才推荐（下一职业预测）存在结构性张力：协同方法擅长挖掘群体转移规律但缺乏准则级解释；序列/强化模型可适应个体轨迹，但在稀疏、短暂、强重复的公开职业历史上难以解释且增益有限；TOPSIS 保留理想解—负理想解的显式排序逻辑，适合需要人工审计的职业属性，却不能替代行为证据。同时公开人才历史基准稀缺且异质，序列动态差异极大（Senger et al. 2024/2025 指出模型结论会随评测场景与 grounding 方式改变），单一数据集上的"更强"很可能反映的是基准regime而非信号融合本身的贡献。此外，人才推荐影响职业探索、招聘与内部流动决策，仅给出黑盒排序列表无法满足多利益方的可追溯需求（Schellingerhout 2024；Tang et al. 2025）。因此需要：(1) 一个结构上可解释、可消融的混合架构；(2) 一个双基准、冻结、时序重复的评测协议来区分"模型贡献"与"数据集特性"。研究问题 RQ1：混合模型是否在主基准上超过强序列/协同/成对混合基线；RQ2：RL 分支相对 CF+TOPSIS 是否有增量价值，还是在持久性主导时坍缩；RQ3：双基准设计是否比单基准评估更可靠。
AI.method: 基准构建：从 JobHop（Hugging Face，CC BY 4.0）与 Karrierewege（公开发布，ESCO 链接）两个公开 ICT 人才历史源出发，用可复现 allow-list 审计筛出 ICT/软件职业子集（JobHop 2778 用户/47 职业/10826 交互/平均序列 3.897；Karrierewege 2617/35/10492/4.009）；仅保留至少 3 个 ICT 职业的用户、至少 25 个不同用户观察到的职业；生成四类冻结工件（有序历史、物品元数据、切分定义、基准元数据）。切分为时序切分：固定种子 20260331 作开发切分，另用种子 100–109 做重复稳健性报告；测试项取序列有效尾部，前一职业作验证，剩余前缀作训练；流行度先验、转移矩阵、TOPSIS 准则矩阵仅在训练前缀上拟合以保证测试隔离。模型（后融合，Eq.1）：S=λ_CF·s_CF+λ_RL·s_RL+λ_T·s_T，非负且和为 1，在验证集选参后原样用于测试。①CF 分支（Eq.2）：转移矩阵 + 转移行余弦相似度，归一化混合 0.85 末项转移向量与 0.15 历史感知成分（内部 γ=0.7 融合转移与相似证据），含近因加权。②RL 分支：职业→职业族（软件工程、基础设施与安全、数据与 AI、数字体验、硬件与自动化、技术管理）的紧凑 bandit，Q(s,a)←Q+η(r−Q)（学习率 0.2，负奖励 −0.2，每正转移 2 个采样负例，30 轮），无 bootstrap；g_u=ω·Q_{f(ℓ_u),:}+(1−ω)·b_u（ω=0.7），s_RL=0.75·g_{f(i)}+0.25·流行度。③TOPSIS 分支：六个语义代理（市场流行度、技能广度、数字技能密度、创新强度、角色层级、转移流动性）构造 X∈R^{|I|×6}，权重 w_u=α·w^{(u)}+(1−α)·w^{(g)}（全局熵权 + 用户近因加权准则画像，α∈{0,.25,.5,.75,1} 验证选择），贴近度 s_T=D⁻/(D⁺+D⁻)。评测：top-5，HR@5/NDCG@5/MRR@5（Precision@5 因单相关项只是 HR@5 的固定缩放故省略），在完整职业全集上排序（允许返回既往职业）；10 次时序切分报告均值与总体标准差，配对 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验（预设计比较，未做多重校正）与 rank-biserial 效应量、Cohen's dz；基线含 Popularity、repeat-last、item Markov、Transition-CF、NMF、SVD、GRU4Rec、SASRec、TOPSIS-only、RL-only 及成对/全混合（λ_CF∈{0..0.7}，λ_RL∈{0..0.5}）。稳健性检查：留一代理敏感性、family-level DQN（隐层 16/32/64）替换 bandit、CPU 墙钟运行时测量、用户级可解释性案例。
AI.result: JobHop（主基准，10 切分均值±总体标准差）：全混合 HR@5=0.4213±0.0093、NDCG@5=0.3040±0.0073、MRR@5=0.2656±0.0073，优于 repeat-last(0.2819)、item Markov(0.2937)、Transition-CF(0.2932)、CF+TOPSIS(0.2924)、GRU4Rec(0.2835)、SASRec(0.2945)；Wilcoxon p=0.002（vs SASRec p=0.0039，r_rb=0.9636），其余 r_rb=1.0，方向完全一致；相对 item Markov 约 +3.5%、相对 CF+TOPSIS 约 +4.0%，dz 分别为 1.87 与 2.77（高 dz 主要源于固定种子下的低方差，非大规模实际效应）。消融显示 TOPSIS-only(0.2117) 与 RL+TOPSIS(0.2629) 明显弱于协同基线，说明 CF 为结构骨架、RL 分支在强协同核心之上提供可测增量。Karrierewege（次基准）：全混合 HR@5=0.7458、NDCG@5=0.6227、MRR@5=0.5818，与 item Markov(0.6218) 差异仅 0.0009 且不显著（p=0.5566, r_rb=0.2364, dz≈0.22），但仍显著优于 repeat-last(0.6034)、Transition-CF(0.6156, p=0.0098)、GRU4Rec(0.5632)、SASRec(0.6125)；CF+TOPSIS 对比 p=0.0625（边缘不显著）。融合权重：JobHop 平均 λ_CF≈0.53、λ_RL≈0.28、λ_T≈0.19；Karrierewege 为 0.69/0.05/0.26，bandit 分支在持久性主导基准上正确地退化为近零。留一代理：JobHop 所有变动均 <0.001 NDCG@5（最大降幅为去 role level，−0.0009），说明 TOPSIS 起分布式微调作用；Karrierewege 上市场流行度最关键（−0.0087）。DQN 检查：family-DQN 单独略优（JobHop 0.2766 vs 0.2726, p=0.0098；Karrierewege 0.4783 vs 0.4755, p=0.0371），但全混合几乎不变（JobHop p=0.9219；Karrierewege 0.6238, p=0.0625），支持轻量 bandit 已足够。运行时：全混合构建+验证 JobHop 10.25 s / Karrierewege 7.85 s，快于 GRU4Rec(11.07/11.58 s) 与 SASRec(20.24/18.88 s)，三者测试打分均约 0.02 s。用户级案例：目标 "user interface developer" 在全混合中排第 3，而 Transition-CF 第 21、item Markov 第 22、CF+TOPSIS 第 31、TOPSIS-only 第 40，归因于同族（数字体验）bandit 提升；该用户权重为 λ_CF=0.5/λ_RL=0.4/λ_T=0.1，TOPSIS 准则集中于市场流行度(0.32)、转移流动性(0.31)、数字技能密度(0.18)。
AI.conclusion: 论文明确放弃"基准无关的普遍优越性"主张，定位为可复现的"基准条件性"实证：透明后融合在语义丰富、非饱和的转移型基准上三分支互证（可捕获简单延续启发式无法吸收的余量）；在持久性主导的基准上同一架构依靠协同骨干保持竞争力，而自适应分支正确地失活，从而证明后融合设计的可审计性本身具有诊断价值。可解释性被定义为设计级/结构性的（分支分数、熵权准则画像、理想—负理想距离、验证选出的融合权重均可直接检视），而非事后 SHAP/LIME 类解释。部署启发式：若 repeat-last 的 NDCG@5 已达 0.55–0.65，混合模型主要保障竞争性与可解释性（无排序代价）；若低于约 0.30，则可从三路融合中回收可测增益。贡献在于证据结构（双基准 + 冻结 + 时序重复 + 消融可见的分支行为）与人才域融合架构的结合，而非全新的基础推荐算法。局限：两基准均为历史序列而非曝光受控在线日志；ICT allow-list 限于英文职位名，迁移需重建清单与代理词典；TOPSIS 用语义代理而非官方薪酬/需求表，缺少外部验证；RL 分支为紧凑 bandit 而非完整在线 deep-RL，职业族分类为固定设计（可由更密 ESCO 层级或转移图聚类改进）；训练前缀长度接近最小值 3 或以精确重复为主的用户的预期增益更小。未来方向：叠加与劳动力市场技能资源更紧密绑定的软件职位验证层、在不牺牲消融纪律下引入上下文/会话感知 RL 分支、构造剔除重复前缀用户的 Karrierewege 子集检验 bandit 是否重新激活、引入面向利益方的解释学研究。

title: Understanding Conversational Patterns in Multi-agent Programming: A Case Study on Fibonacci Game Development
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to software engineering (SE), yet their potential for autonomous, role-oriented collaboration remains largely underexplored. Understanding how multiple LLM-based agents coordinate, maintain role alignment, and converge on solutions is critical for SE, as naively allowing agents to interact does not reliably lead to correct or stable outcomes. Recent empirical studies show that unstructured or poorly understood interaction dynamics can result in error propagation, premature consensus on incorrect solutions, or prolonged disagreement that prevents convergence, even when correct partial solutions are present early in the interaction. As an initial step towards addressing this underexplored area, we undertake a systematic analysis of conversations between two agents, a Designer and a Programmer across 12 model combinations from 7 open-source LLMs (Gemma 2, Gemma 3, LLaMA 3.2, LLaMA 3.3, DeepSeek-R1, MiniCPM, and Qwen3). Our systematic approach reveals three key dimensions of multi-agent interaction: efficiency (the speed and stability of convergence), consistency (the degree of role alignment visualized by BLEU and ROUGE), and effectiveness (the extent of compilation success and error resolution). Results show that the DeepSeek-R1:DeepSeek-R1 pair was unique in converging to the correct solution from the very first iteration and sustaining it consistently to the final iteration, while LLaMA 3.2:LLaMA 3.2 and Qwen3:Qwen3 demonstrated strong Designer:Programmer role alignment despite of diverging from the correct solution. The other pairs deviated from the task, never to converge to a result. These findings advance understanding of agentic programming and highlight the need for further research on understanding and calibrating convergence and stop conditions essential for future autonomous SE.

AI.tldr: 本文以"用 C 语言编写一个 Fibonacci 数学游戏"为单一用例，系统分析了由 7 个开源 LLM（Gemma 2/3、LLaMA 3.2/3.3、DeepSeek-R1、MiniCPM、Qwen3）构成的 12 种 Designer:Programmer 智能体配对的对话轨迹，从"效率（收敛速度与稳定性）、一致性（BLEU/ROUGE 角色对齐）、有效性（编译成功率）"三个维度刻画多智能体协作动态。核心发现：三个维度相互解耦——DeepSeek-R1:DeepSeek-R1 是唯一从第一轮即产出正确解并保持到最后、但语义高度回声且编译成功率仅 3.29% 的组合；Qwen3:Qwen3 与 LLaMA 3.2:LLaMA 3.2 角色对齐强、编译成功率 100%，却从未得到正确解；其余配对则偏离任务、无法收敛。研究主张以重复率、主题黏附度、角色稳定性等交互轨迹信号定义停止条件与健康监控机制。
AI.motivation: LLM 已广泛用于软件工程（Copilot、ChatGPT、CodeWhisperer 在 HumanEval/MBPP 等基准上表现良好），多智能体 LLM 系统被认为可通过角色分工与协作处理复杂 SE 任务。但现有评测多聚焦于短小、自封闭的任务，缺少对智能体在长程交互中如何保持任务焦点、维持角色一致性、协调收敛的实证理解。已有研究表明无约束的智能体交互会系统性失败：错误传播、对错误解的过早共识、无法收敛的分歧，即使早期已出现正确的部分解。因此"简单允许智能体交互"并不足以构建可靠的自主 SE 系统，需要先刻画交互动态本身。研究动机并非评测任务难度或基准性能，而是理解角色化 LLM 智能体在迭代编程中的对话模式、角色遵循、行为漂移与交互停滞。
AI.method: 采用轻量可控的智能体框架：中央 Controller（Python 脚本）负责确定性轮次切换、消息路由、终止条件与日志；Programmer（仅输出 C 代码，无注释解释）与 Designer（给出设计建议、重构指导）各以固定系统提示一次性初始化，通过累积消息历史维持角色条件。参数：temperature=0.5（0.3–1.0 预实验选定以减少重复与幻觉）、max tokens=4096、最大迭代上限 10000（用于观察智能体能持续对话多久及重复趋势），每个配对运行两次且行为无实质差异。任务为单一开放性任务 "Write a mathematical game of Fibonacci"，以避免任务复杂度混淆。12 种配对覆盖对称（同模型不同规模）、非对称（大小模型组合）、跨架构（含通用模型与代码/推理型模型）三类；部署于 RTX 5090（32GB VRAM）与 NVIDIA GB10（128GB 统一内存）两台服务器，Ollama 0.12.10 推理，Python 3.10.12 编排。分析方法：RQ1 对对话日志做主题分析（Braun & Clarke），由两位作者独立编码并以 Cohen's κ=0.71 校验一致性，归纳出成功/失败模式（SFP1 成功收敛、SFP2 未启动、SFP3 启动后发散）与对话行为模式（CBP1 回声、CBP2 浅层交互、CBP3 跨语言/平台偏离、CBP4 结论式收敛）；RQ2 归纳式主题分类并合并细粒度主题；RQ3 测量每轮词数、BLEU（程序员输出对设计师上轮的匹配度）与 ROUGE（设计师内容在程序员回复中的召回度），并结合人工标注判断每轮所处的 SE 活动（设计、实现、重构、测试、验证）；RQ4 用 GCC 11.4.0 抽取对话中的 C 代码编译，每个轮次判定为编译成功/失败/未找到代码。
AI.result: RQ1：仅 DeepSeek-R1:DeepSeek-R1 从第一轮起即产出正确解并维持至最后一轮；Qwen3:DeepSeek-R1（3 轮后）、DeepSeek-R1:LLaMA 3.3（21 轮后）、LLaMA 3.3:LLaMA 3.3（69 轮后）启动于正确解但随后发散且未恢复，其余配对从未得到正确解。多数配对在若干轮后出现 CBP1 回声（Gemma3:DeepSeek-R1 9730 轮、Qwen3:DeepSeek-R1 9678 轮、DeepSeek-R1:DeepSeek-R1 7655 轮）；Gemma3:Gemma3 为唯一出现 CBP4 结论式道别的配对；Gemma3:MiniCPM、DeepSeek-R1:LLaMA 3.3、LLaMA 3.2:DeepSeek-R1 出现中文等跨语言漂移（CBP3）。语言分布为 C 61%、C++ 37.9%、Python 1.1%，个别配对还产出 C#/JavaScript；DeepSeek-R1:DeepSeek-R1、Qwen3:Qwen3 及 LLaMA:LLaMA 变体未使用英语与 C 以外的语言。RQ2：主题高度多样，最高频为 Fibonacci 程序（28.13%）、二项式系数计算（25.25%）、C 头文件使用讨论（25.16%）；Gemma3:DeepSeek-R1 与 Qwen3:DeepSeek-R1 主题分布极度偏斜（长上须与 log 轴远点），DeepSeek-R1:DeepSeek-R1 中位数与离散度显著更高，Gemma3:Gemma3 等则较均衡；LLaMA 3.2:DeepSeek-R1 与 Gemma3:Gemma2 主题探索更宽（排序、打印程序、CLI 工具等），DeepSeek-R1:MiniCPM 是唯一引入指针程序等冷门主题的配对。RQ3：Qwen3:Qwen3 与 LLaMA 3.2:LLaMA 3.2 的 BLEU 高而平稳（非平坦），对应真实语义对齐且持续变化；DeepSeek-R1:DeepSeek-R1 与 Qwen3:DeepSeek-R1 的 BLEU/ROUGE 平坦于 1.0，属语义回声——前者虽语义质量低却维持了收敛；Gemma3:Gemma3、LLaMA 3.3:LLaMA 3.3 出现延迟的 BLEU/ROUGE 尖峰。词数小提琴图显示 Designer 普遍比 Programmer 冗长，但对称性差异极大：DeepSeek-R1:MiniCPM、Gemma3:DeepSeek-R1、LLaMA 3.2:DeepSeek-R1 极度失衡（常伴停滞/回声），而 LLaMA 3.2:LLaMA 3.2、Qwen3:Qwen3、LLaMA 3.3:LLaMA 3.3 双方分布交叠但有区分，说明同模型配对并不必然回声。人工分析进一步发现 Gemma3:Gemma3 与 LLaMA 3.2:DeepSeek-R1 在若干轮后出现角色互换；所有成功启动的案例均由 Programmer 主导，而多数发散由 Designer 引入无关相关话题触发。RQ4：LLaMA 3.2:LLaMA 3.2 与 Qwen3:Qwen3 编译成功率 100%；Qwen3:DeepSeek-R1、Gemma3:DeepSeek-R1、Gemma3:MiniCPM 处于 45–77% 的中档；DeepSeek-R1:MiniCPM 与 LLaMA 3.3:LLaMA 3.3 降至约 30–40%，失败率高达 62%；Gemma3:Gemma3 与 DeepSeek-R1:DeepSeek-R1 的"未找到代码"占比达 68–95%，人工核查发现多因双方共同给出编译/执行指令而非代码。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体编程的性能主要取决于角色分离、配对兼容性与交互动态，而非模型规模或表面词汇相似度；收敛性、语义对齐与编译成功率三者不一致——强对齐不保证正确，正确收敛也可能伴随回声等"病态"交互特征，推理能力本身不足以保证稳定协作。实证上"早期正确解的出现可预测最终成功"，一旦发散则极少恢复（观测上限 69 轮），这为多智能体 SE 系统定义显式停止条件、交互轨迹监控（重复率、主题黏附度、角色稳定性）与终止策略提供了依据；推理模型与非推理模型配对存在语义回声而任务不推进的风险，同模型非推理配对（LLaMA 3.2/3.3、Qwen3）则在需求协商、设计探索、重构等长对话场景更有潜力。作者承认有效性威胁：单一任务与单一语言、固定提示与角色条件、仅 12 种开源组合，难以推广到闭源模型与更复杂任务；BLEU/ROUGE 亦难以捕捉改写式正确性，故辅以人工标注与收敛分析。后续工作将扩展至更复杂任务、更多配对与更丰富工具集成，并区分 DeepSeek-R1 的收敛源自推理式设计还是模型规模；论文另发布包含对话数据集、编排代码与复现说明的开放复现包。

title: KT4EQG: Personalized Exercise Question Generation via Knowledge Tracing
summary: Educational Question Generation (EQG) aims to synthesize customized exercise questions that enhance student learning. An effective EQG system should ideally personalize questions for each student by modeling the student's knowledge state and generating questions that provide the greatest learning benefit. However, few existing EQG approaches are able to achieve such fine-grained personalization. In this paper, we explore how EQG can benefit from knowledge tracing (KT), which models students' knowledge states based on historical performance and predicts future performance. We propose KT4EQG, a personalized EQG framework that generates effective questions for individual students under the guidance of a KT model. Specifically, KT4EQG seeks to maximize a student's potential improvement in overall knowledge mastery by leveraging the KT model to select the most suitable knowledge concept for the student to practice. An LLM-based question generator is then trained to produce a question faithfully grounded in the selected concept. Experimental results on XES3G5M and MOOCRadar show that KT4EQG consistently generates more effective questions than methods with limited or no personalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KT4EQG框架，通过知识追踪模型指导教育问题生成，实现面向个体学生的精细化个性化题目推荐。框架核心在于利用KT模型评估每个知识点对学生提升潜力的贡献，选取最优知识点后由LLM生成相应题目。实验验证了该方法相比非个性化方法的优越性。
AI.motivation: 现有教育问题生成方法难以实现细粒度的个性化问题生成，无法针对每位学生的知识状态定制最有益的练习题目。
AI.method: KT4EQG框架首先利用KT模型预测学生的知识状态，选择最能提升学生整体知识掌握度的知识点，然后基于选定概念训练LLM问题生成器生成相应问题。
AI.result: 在XES3G5M和MOOCRadar数据集上的实验表明，KT4EQG在学生提升潜力方面始终优于个性化程度较低的方法。
AI.conclusion: KT4EQG通过结合知识追踪与问题生成，在个性化教育问题生成上取得了显著效果，验证了知识追踪指导下的个性化问题生成策略的有效性。

title: AvalancheBench: Evaluating Enterprise Data Agents Through Latent World Recovery
summary: We introduce AvalancheBench, a benchmark for evaluating enterprise data agents through \emph{latent world recovery}. AvalancheBench improves on existing benchmarks in three ways. First, it evaluates analytical understanding rather than pipeline completion: systems are scored on whether they recover the segments, drivers, temporal events, and relationships that explain the data, not merely on whether they execute a workflow or produce a plausible report. Second, it provides ground truth for goal-driven analytics by generating observations from a known latent world, enabling partial credit for incomplete but valid recoveries. Third, it exposes how early analytical mistakes propagate into later conclusions: missed segments, merged events, or wrong attributions can lead to systematically wrong recommendations. In this sense, AvalancheBench complements real-data benchmarks by providing a controlled setting for diagnosing whether agents recover the analytical structure behind enterprise data. On a first e-commerce use case, the strongest configuration of a leading coding agent recovers only 26\% of the rubric, with failures concentrated in generic customer segmentations and merged temporal events.

AI.tldr: AvalancheBench是一个评估企业数据智能体的新基准，通过"潜在世界恢复"来检验智能体是否真正理解数据的分析结构，而非仅完成流水线或生成合理报告。该基准通过已知参数生成的观测数据提供真实标签，支持部分评分，并可追踪早期错误如何导致系统性错误的最终结论。初步测试显示当前最强编码智能体仅达到26%的恢复率。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试仅评估流水线完成度或报告生成的合理性，无法真正衡量智能体是否恢复了数据背后的分析结构。关键问题是：智能体是否理解数据的语义组成（分段、驱动因素、时间事件及其关系），而不仅仅是执行工作流或产出看似合理的输出。
AI.method: 该基准通过"潜在世界恢复"范式评估企业数据智能体：从未知参数生成的观测数据出发，评估系统是否正确恢复了数据背后的分割结构、驱动因素、时间事件和关系。同时支持部分评分，以奖励不完整但正确的恢复结果。
AI.result: 在电子商务用例的初步测试中，即使是最强配置的领先编码智能体也仅恢复了26%的评分标准。典型失败模式包括：产生过于通用的客户分段，以及错误地合并时间事件。
AI.conclusion: 当前最强编码智能体在AvalancheBench电子商务测试中仅获得26%的评分，主要失败集中在通用客户细分和时间事件的合并上。该基准提供了一个受控环境，能够诊断智能体是否正确恢复了企业数据背后的分析结构，有效弥补了真实数据基准的不足。

title: Toward Reliable Design of LLM-Enabled Agentic Workflows: Optimizing Latency-Reliability-Cost Tradeoffs
summary: Modern AI systems increasingly rely on workflows composed of multiple interacting agents, some powered by large language models (LLMs) and others by conventional computational modules. This paper analyzes the fundamental tradeoffs between latency, reliability, and cost in LLM-enabled agentic workflows. We introduce performance models for both LLM and non-LLM agents that capture the relationship between computational effort and output quality, incorporating the impact of reasoning and output tokens for LLM agents using a parametric exponential reliability function. Then, we study the design of sequential workflows under latency and cost constraints. Main results include a water-filling token allocation policy and characterizations of optimal workflow reliability in terms of shadow prices.

AI.tldr: 本文为 LLM 智能体工作流建立"延迟—可靠性—成本"三维权衡的性能模型：在延迟与用户成本预算约束下，用凸优化求解序贯工作流中各 LLM 智能体的输出 token 分配，得到闭式的"注水式"(water-filling) 分配策略，并给出以影子价格 θ 刻画的最优工作流可靠性表达式。
AI.motivation: 现代 AI 系统越来越多地由多个交互智能体（部分是 LLM，部分是数据库查询、优化求解器、验证工具等传统计算模块）组成的工作流驱动，其部署资源消耗大，而实际配置多依赖启发式规则或昂贵的试错，缺乏可分析、可优化的数学框架。从系统角度看，工作流性能由三个关键量刻画：延迟、可靠性与成本，需要理解单个智能体特性如何随结构组合为整体行为，从而在满足延迟/成本预算的前提下最大化可靠性。
AI.method: 1) 智能体级性能模型：LLM 智能体 j 以推理 token 数 X_j 与输出 token 数 L_j 为资源变量；延迟 T_j = τ_j + X_j/λ_th + L_j/λ_gen（τ_j 为随机基础设施时延，均值为 τ̄_j）；可靠性用参数化指数形式 ρ_j(X_j,L_j) = (1−e^{−α_j X_j})(1−e^{−β_j L_j})，刻画双维度上的边际收益递减；成本分用户可见成本 C_j^u = c_tok L_j 与系统计算成本 C_j^c = c_comp(X_j+L_j)，其中 c_comp 可由每 token FLOPs（2β+2n^layer n^ctx n^attn）乘单位 FLOP 货币成本 c_e 得到。2) 非 LLM 智能体：确定性/算法型计算，用排队论抽象（如服务时间服从速率 λ_i 的指数分布时 E[T_i]=1/λ_i），其 (T_i, ρ_i) 为固定参数。3) 工作流聚合规则：串行（延迟相加、可靠性相乘）、并行（延迟取 E[max(T_i,T_j)]，可靠性分合取 ρ_iρ_j 与冗余 1−(1−ρ_i)(1−ρ_j)）、反馈回路（K 次迭代，延迟 K(E[T_i]+E[T_j])，可靠性 (ρ_iρ_j)^K）。4) 优化问题：在延迟约束 T 与用户成本预算 C 下最大化 ∏ ρ̂_j(L_j)；由对数等价变换并固定 X_j 为常数，化为 max Σ_j log(1−e^{−β_j L_j})，s.t. Σ L_j/λ_gen ≤ B_T、c_tok Σ L_j ≤ C、L_j ≥ 0；通过 KKT 条件求解，定义有效 token 预算 B = min{λ_gen B_T, C/c_tok}。数值实验：n=5 个 LLM 智能体，β_j ∈ {0.001, 0.002, 0.0005, 0.003, 0.0015}，B=12000 tokens，对比均匀/正比/反比基线策略。
AI.result: 命题 1（注水式 token 分配）：最优响应长度 L_j* = [ (1/β_j)·log(1+β_j/θ) ]_+，其中 θ ≥ 0 为有效预算约束的拉格朗日乘子，由 Σ_j L_j* = B 唯一确定；因目标严格凹且可行集凸，KKT 充要且解唯一。注 3.2（影子价格解释）：θ 是 token 预算的影子价格，表示额外一个 token 在对数可靠性上的边际价值；所有 L_j*>0 的智能体满足 ∂ log ρ_j/∂L_j = θ，即最优化分配使各活跃智能体的"每 token 对数可靠性边际增益"相等。推论 3.3：最优工作流可靠性 R_wf* = ∏_j (1−e^{−α_j X_j})·β_j/(β_j+θ)。实验结论：注水规则把更多 token 分给 β_j 较小（可靠性提升慢）的智能体，因 β_j 大的智能体用较少 token 即可达到高可靠性；图 2 显示该分配策略在不同 token 预算下均一致优于均匀、正比与反比三种基线。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一个分析并优化 LLM 智能体工作流的框架，量化了可靠性、延迟、成本之间的权衡，在延迟与成本双约束下推导了序贯工作流的闭式最优 token 分配策略：最优分配使各智能体的对数可靠性边际增益相等，由反映 token 预算稀缺性的影子价格刻画。局限与展望：仅聚焦序贯（可视为复合模块的串接）结构、假定各智能体故障独立、并将推理 token 分配 X_j 视为固定；未来工作包括推理长度与响应长度的联合优化，以及依据中间结果动态调整 token 预算的自适应分配策略。

title: EchoDistill:Alignment Noisy-to-Clean Self-Distillation for Robust Audio LLMs
summary: Audio Large Language Models (ALLMs) are highly vulnerable to real-world noise, which often induces severe semantic drift and hallucinations. Existing robustness methods primarily rely on waveform-level acoustic enhancement, answer-level supervision, or the internal suppression of noise representations. To address these issues, we propose echodistill, an alignment-based noisy-to-clean self-distillation framework. Echodistill leverages a frozen clean-audio teacher to provide semantic references for an inference-time noisy-audio student. Specifically, the student samples candidate responses under noisy conditions to expose its test-time behavior. These trajectories are then optimized via group-relative policy optimization (GRPO), where the token-level consistency with the teacher acts as a reward bonus. By aligning the noisy student's candidate responses with clean semantic evidence, and applying audio-aware reward shaping, our method encourages reasoning trajectories that are both correct and genuinely acoustically grounded. Echodistill significantly improves the semantic reliability and task performance of Audio LLMs under complex noise, without introducing any additional inference costs. Extensive experiments show that: (I) Compared with the strongest baseline, echodistill achieves average improvements of 4.18\%$\uparrow$ in GSR under strong noise. (II) Ablation results on Qwen-Omni further show that echodistill improves over the GRPO-only variant by 3.02\%$\uparrow$ in Acc, 3.89\%$\uparrow$ in Noisy, and 4.53\%$\uparrow$ in GSR on average. Our codes are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/echodistill-10DE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EchoDistill，一种用于提升音频大语言模型在噪声环境下鲁棒性的自蒸馏对齐框架。通过利用干净音频教师指导噪声学生的推理过程，并结合GRPO优化和音频感知奖励塑造，该方法在不增加推理成本的前提下显著提升了模型在复杂噪声条件下的语义可靠性和任务性能。
AI.motivation: 音频大语言模型（ALLMs）在现实世界噪声面前非常脆弱，噪声往往导致严重的语义漂移和幻觉问题。现有鲁棒性方法主要依赖于波形级声学增强、答案级监督或噪声表示的内部抑制，这些方法存在局限性。
AI.method: 提出EchoDistill，一种基于对齐的噪声到干净的自蒸馏框架。具体包括：1) 利用冻结的干净音频教师为推理时的噪声音频学生提供语义参考；2) 学生在噪声条件下采样候选响应以暴露其测试时行为；3) 通过GRPO（群体相对策略优化）优化这些轨迹，以教师在token级别的一致性作为奖励加成；4) 应用音频感知的奖励塑造，鼓励推理轨迹既正确又真正基于声学。
AI.result: 实验表明：（I）与最强基线相比，EchoDistill在强噪声下GRS平均提升4.18%；（II）在Qwen-Omni上的消融实验显示，EchoDistill相比GRPO-only变体平均提升Acc 3.02%、Noisy 3.89%、GSR 4.53%。
AI.conclusion: EchoDistill通过对齐噪声学生的候选响应与干净语义证据，并应用音频感知的奖励塑造，显著提升了音频大语言模型在复杂噪声环境下的语义可靠性和任务性能，且不引入额外的推理成本。

title: Iterative Refinement Neural Operators are Learned Fixed-Point Solvers: A Principled Approach to Spectral Bias Mitigation
comment: 47 pages; accepted to ICML 2026 as a Spotlight
summary: Neural operators serve as fast, data-driven surrogates for scientific modeling but typically rely on a monolithic, single-pass inference procedure that struggles to resolve high-frequency details, a limitation known as spectral bias. We introduce the Iterative Refinement Neural Operator (IRNO), which augments pre-trained operators with a learned refinement module iteratively applied via fixed-point iteration. IRNO decomposes the prediction into a coarse initialization followed by successive residual corrections, paralleling classical numerical solvers. Under local assumptions, we establish contraction of the induced operator, ensuring convergence to a unique fixed point. To explicitly target high-frequency errors, we propose a progressive spectral loss that adaptively increases penalty on high-frequency components over refinement steps during training. Across physical systems, IRNO consistently lowers error, with up to 56.05% improvement on turbulent flow. On Active Matter, spectral analysis reveals that, relative to base operator, the normalized error ratios decrease to 27.72-36.10% in low-, 5.07-6.68% in mid-, and 1.48-2.04% in high-frequencies, remaining stable beyond the trained iteration count. Code is available at https://github.com/xiaotianliu-dartmouth/Iterative_Refinement_Neural_Operator

AI.tldr: IRNO addresses spectral bias in neural operators by adding a learned refinement module with fixed-point iteration, achieving up to 56% error reduction on turbulent flow and significantly better high-frequency resolution.
AI.motivation: Neural operators for scientific modeling suffer from spectral bias - struggle to resolve high-frequency details due to single-pass inference procedure.
AI.method: Iterative Refinement Neural Operator (IRNO): uses learned refinement module with fixed-point iteration, decomposing prediction into coarse initialization + successive residual corrections; Progressive spectral loss that adaptively increases penalty on high-frequency components during training.
AI.result: Up to 56.05% error improvement on turbulent flow; normalized error ratios decrease to 27.72-36.10% (low-freq), 5.07-6.68% (mid-freq), and 1.48-2.04% (high-freq) relative to base operator; stable beyond trained iteration count.
AI.conclusion: IRNO provides a principled framework for iterative refinement of neural operators with theoretical convergence guarantees, achieving significant error reductions especially in high-frequency components while maintaining stability beyond trained iteration counts.

title: Algorithms with Polynomially-Improved Approximation Factors for the $2 \rightarrow q$ Norm, and Applications
summary:
The $2 \rightarrow q$ norm of a matrix $X \in \mathbb{R}^{n \times d}$ is defined as $\lVert X \rVert_{2 \rightarrow q} = \sup_{\lVert v \rVert_2 = 1} \lVert Xv \rVert_q$. We give polynomial-time multiplicative approximation algorithms for this norm when $q > 2$ (i.e. in the hypercontractive setting). This problem either directly captures or is closely related to long-standing open problems in combinatorial optimization and hardness of approximation (e.g. Small Set Expansion), quantum information (e.g. Best Separable State), and algorithmic statistics.
  Very little is known about what approximation factors we can achieve for this problem in polynomial time, even though such approximations have significant downstream consequences. Barak, Brandão, Harrow, Kelner, Steurer, and Zhou showed that no polynomial-time algorithm can achieve an approximation factor better than $2^{\sqrt{\log n}}$, assuming the Exponential Time Hypothesis (FOCS'12). On the other hand, a simple spectral algorithm gives a $d^{1/4}$-approximation as a baseline. We give, to the best of our knowledge, the first polynomial-time approximation algorithm beating this baseline by polynomial factors. For the important special case of $q = 4$ it achieves a $d^{1/8}$-approximation. All previous algorithms required additional assumptions on $X$, or only surpassed the baseline for small values of $n$.
  Moreover, we construct sum-of-squares certificates for the $2 \rightarrow q$ norm. This directly implies improved algorithms for robust mean and covariance estimation, robust regression, and clustering, when the data only satisfies a bound on its $q$-th moment.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了矩阵X的2→q范数近似问题，给出q>2时首个超越简单谱基线(d^(1/4))的多项式时间乘法近似算法，对q=4达d^(1/8)近似，并构造了SoS证书用于鲁棒统计估计。
AI.motivation: 2→q范数问题与组合优化中的Small Set Expansion、量子信息中的Best Separable State等问题密切相关近似因子对下游应用有重要影响此前仅知d^(1/4)-近似基线且算法需额外假设
AI.method: 设计多项式时间乘法近似算法，针对q>2的超压缩情形。构建2→q范数的平方和(SoS)证书。
AI.result: 首次在多项式时间内超越d^(1/4)基线；q=4时实现d^(1/8)-近似；构造SoS证书并导出鲁棒估计等应用的有效算法
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次在多项式时间内实现超越d^(1/4)基线的多项式因子改进，对q=4特殊情况达到d^(1/8)近似。进一步，SoS证明器直接应用于鲁棒均值/协方差估计、鲁棒回归和聚类等任务。

title: TSFLora: Token-Compressed Split Fine-Tuning for Wireless Edge Networks
summary: Adapting large AI models (LAMs) to personalized edge data is challenging because wireless devices have limited memory, computation, and uplink capacity. Federated fine-tuning preserves data privacy but still requires each device to host the full model, while split learning reduces device memory at the cost of heavy activation transmission. This paper proposes TSFLora, a token-compressed split fine-tuning framework for communication-efficient LAM adaptation at the edge.
